metadata.name: Error pages
metadata.description: Serves a maintenance page and error pages (404, 502, 503, 504) from HTML in a ConfigMap, for Traefik errors middlewares and Ingress or HTTPRoute backends in the same namespace.

security.summary: The pod cannot reach the Kubernetes API. It runs as non-root UID 101 with a read-only filesystem and no extra capabilities, and it makes no outbound connections. The Service and the ConfigMap of pages carry the label zeabur.com/page-server=true, which Zeabur uses to find the page server.

zh-CN.summary: Pod 无法访问 Kubernetes API。它以非 root 的 UID 101 运行，文件系统只读，没有多余的权限，也不会主动对外连接。Service 和存放页面的 ConfigMap 都带有 zeabur.com/page-server=true 标签，Zeabur 靠这个标签找到页面服务器。

zh-TW.summary: Pod 無法存取 Kubernetes API。它以非 root 的 UID 101 執行，檔案系統唯讀，沒有多餘的權限，也不會主動對外連線。Service 和放頁面的 ConfigMap 都帶有 zeabur.com/page-server=true 標籤，Zeabur 靠這個標籤找到頁面伺服器。

risks.risk: Anyone who can edit the ConfigMap changes what visitors see.
risks.mitigation: Give edit rights on ConfigMaps only to people who may change the site. The server sends the HTML as is and runs no code.

zh-CN.risk: 能编辑 ConfigMap 的人，就能改变访客看到的内容。
zh-CN.mitigation: 只把 ConfigMap 的编辑权限给可以修改网站的人。服务器会原样送出 HTML，不会执行任何代码。

zh-TW.risk: 能編輯 ConfigMap 的人，就能改變訪客看到的內容。
zh-TW.mitigation: 只把 ConfigMap 的編輯權限給可以修改網站的人。伺服器會原封不動送出 HTML，不會執行任何程式。

scalability.summary: Stateless responses; replicas can scale horizontally. The pages come from the ConfigMap, and the kubelet updates them in every pod.
blockers: One replica shows no pages while its pod restarts or moves. Add replicas and a PodDisruptionBudget when the maintenance page must stay up during node drains.

upgradeNotes: Check the nginx configuration in the error-pages-nginx ConfigMap and the image vulnerability reports before you accept a digest update.
No data migration. A rollback only reverts the image.

security.summary: Ghost's workloads run in their own namespace, pinned by image digest, as non-root with a read-only root filesystem, no API token and extra capabilities dropped. Outbound traffic is not limited.

zh-CN.summary: Ghost 的工作负载在自己的命名空间里运行，镜像以 digest 固定版本，以非 root 身份运行，根文件系统只读，没有 API token，多余的权限也都去掉了。对外连接没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: Ghost 的工作負載在自己的命名空間裡執行，映像檔以 digest 固定版本，以非 root 身分執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有 API token，多餘的權限也都拿掉了。對外連線沒有限制。

risks.risk: If Ghost has not been set up yet, the first visitor can create the site owner.
risks.mitigation: As soon as Ghost answers, the ghost-setup Job creates the owner from ownerEmail and the generated password in ghost-secrets/admin-password. It checks every two seconds, so the window before it runs is short. /ghost and its APIs are open to anyone who can reach the domain, and Ghost has its own sign-in. To limit who can reach /ghost, add an IP limit in the service's network settings.

zh-CN.risk: 如果 Ghost 还没完成初始化，第一个来的访客就能创建网站所有者。
zh-CN.mitigation: Ghost 一能响应，ghost-setup Job 就会用 ownerEmail 和 ghost-secrets/admin-password 里生成的密码创建所有者。它每两秒检查一次，所以空窗期很短。任何能访问该域名的人都能打开 /ghost 和它的 API，Ghost 本身有登录机制。想限制谁能访问 /ghost，请在服务的网络设置里添加 IP 限制。

zh-TW.risk: 如果 Ghost 還沒完成初始化，第一個來的訪客就能建立網站擁有者。
zh-TW.mitigation: Ghost 一能回應，ghost-setup Job 就會用 ownerEmail 和 ghost-secrets/admin-password 裡產生的密碼建立擁有者。它每兩秒檢查一次，所以空窗期很短。任何連得到網域的人都能打開 /ghost 和它的 API，Ghost 本身有登入機制。想限制誰能連到 /ghost，請在服務的網路設定裡加上 IP 限制。

risks.risk: MySQL runs as a plain StatefulSet, with no operator to manage it.
risks.mitigation: Keep one replica. Store both the MySQL backups and the content backups off the node, and protect them. Add a MySQL operator from the catalog before you promise high availability or automatic point-in-time recovery.

zh-CN.risk: MySQL 是以普通的 StatefulSet 运行，没有 operator 在管理。
zh-CN.mitigation: 只保留一个副本。MySQL 备份和内容备份都要存放在节点之外，并妥善保护。在承诺高可用或自动恢复到任意时间点之前，请先从目录添加 MySQL operator。

zh-TW.risk: MySQL 是以單純的 StatefulSet 執行，沒有 operator 在管理。
zh-TW.mitigation: 只保留一個副本。MySQL 備份和內容備份都要存在節點以外的地方，並妥善保護。在承諾高可用或自動還原到任意時間點之前，請先從目錄加入 MySQL operator。

risks.risk: Ghost depends on outside services to send transactional email and newsletters.
risks.mitigation: Provide an existing SMTP Secret. Set up Mailgun in Ghost for bulk newsletters. Protect the provider credentials in your backups. Self-hosted ActivityPub and Tinybird analytics are not included.

zh-CN.risk: Ghost 发送事务邮件和电子报，要依赖外部服务。
zh-CN.mitigation: 请提供现成的 SMTP 机密。大量发送电子报时，在 Ghost 里设置 Mailgun。备份里的服务商凭证要妥善保护。模板不含自托管的 ActivityPub 和 Tinybird 分析。

zh-TW.risk: Ghost 寄交易通知信和電子報，要靠外部服務。
zh-TW.mitigation: 請提供現成的 SMTP 機密。大量寄送電子報時，在 Ghost 裡設定 Mailgun。備份裡的服務商憑證要妥善保護。範本不含自架的 ActivityPub 和 Tinybird 分析。

scalability.summary: One writable instance backed by one volume. The template has no high availability.
blockers: A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.
A single writable application instance is intentional; do not increase replicas without an application-specific storage/database design.

upgradeNotes: The ghost-setup Job creates the site owner at deploy time. On an existing site it finds the setup already done and changes nothing. A Job cannot be changed after it ran; delete it before you apply a new version.
Back up persistent application data and its database to storage outside the node before updating the image digest.
Restore into a separate namespace before upgrading. Image rollback does not reverse Ghost or MySQL schema migrations.

Fresh deployments use MySQL 8.4 LTS, which Ghost's official hosting guide supports. Existing 8.0 volumes require a rehearsed backup/restore or supported upgrade. MySQL 8.4 disables mysql_native_password by default; migrate those users to caching_sha2_password before upgrading.
MySQL initialization credentials apply only to empty data directories; use SQL for subsequent rotation. Back up MySQL and Ghost content together.

metadata.name: Gitea
metadata.description: Gitea Git hosting over HTTPS, with repositories and LFS objects on a persistent volume and PostgreSQL 18 managed by CloudNativePG.

inputs.name: adminPassword
inputs.description: Password of the administrator gitea_admin, created at the first start. Change it in Gitea after you sign in; the Secret is not applied again.

inputs.name: secretKey
inputs.description: Encrypts stored credentials such as two-factor secrets. Keep it for the life of the database.

inputs.name: internalToken
inputs.description: Authenticates Git hooks to the Gitea web process.

inputs.name: jwtSecret
inputs.description: Signs OAuth2 tokens. Rotating it signs out OAuth2 clients.

inputs.name: lfsJwtSecret

security.summary: The rootless image runs as UID 1000 with a read-only root filesystem, no service-account token and all capabilities dropped. Outbound traffic is not limited. Sign-up is closed and the install page is locked.

zh-CN.summary: 免 root 的镜像以 UID 1000 运行，根文件系统只读，没有服务账号 token，所有额外权限都去掉了。对外连接没有限制。注册已关闭，安装页面也锁住了。

zh-TW.summary: 免 root 的映像檔以 UID 1000 執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有服務帳號 token，所有額外權限都拿掉了。對外連線沒有限制。註冊已關閉，安裝頁面也鎖住了。

risks.risk: If the install page is not locked, the first visitor can configure the server.
risks.mitigation: INSTALL_LOCK is true and the settings come from environment variables. Before Gitea starts, an init container creates the gitea_admin account with the generated password.

zh-CN.risk: 安装页面如果没锁，第一个来的访客就能配置这台服务器。
zh-CN.mitigation: INSTALL_LOCK 设为 true，配置都来自环境变量。Gitea 启动前，初始化容器会用生成好的密码创建 gitea_admin 账号。

zh-TW.risk: 安裝頁面如果沒鎖，第一個來的訪客就能設定這台伺服器。
zh-TW.mitigation: INSTALL_LOCK 設為 true，設定都來自環境變數。Gitea 啟動前，初始化容器會用產生好的密碼建立 gitea_admin 帳號。

risks.risk: Anyone could register an account.
risks.mitigation: DISABLE_REGISTRATION is true. The administrator creates users in Site Administration.

zh-CN.risk: 任何人都可以自己注册账号。
zh-CN.mitigation: DISABLE_REGISTRATION 设为 true。用户由管理员在站点管理里创建。

zh-TW.risk: 任何人都可以自己註冊帳號。
zh-TW.mitigation: DISABLE_REGISTRATION 設為 true。使用者由管理員在網站管理裡建立。

risks.risk: Git over SSH does not work.
risks.mitigation: The Ingress carries HTTP only, so the SSH server is off. Clone and push over HTTPS with a password or an access token.

zh-CN.risk: 无法使用 SSH 访问 Git。
zh-CN.mitigation: Ingress 只转发 HTTP，所以 SSH 服务器是关闭的。请用 HTTPS 搭配密码或访问 token 来 clone 和 push。

zh-TW.risk: 無法使用 SSH 存取 Git。
zh-TW.mitigation: Ingress 只轉送 HTTP，所以 SSH 伺服器是關閉的。請用 HTTPS 搭配密碼或存取 token 來 clone 和 push。

risks.risk: Webhooks, mirrors and repository migrations make the server send requests to addresses that users choose.
risks.mitigation: Gitea blocks private webhook targets by default. The template does not limit outbound traffic. To limit it, add an egress NetworkPolicy. No SMTP server is set up, so Gitea sends no email.

zh-CN.risk: Webhook、镜像和仓库迁移，都会让服务器去访问用户指定的地址。
zh-CN.mitigation: Gitea 默认会拦截指向私有地址的 webhook。模板没有限制对外连接，想限制的话，请添加 egress NetworkPolicy。模板没有配置 SMTP 服务器，所以 Gitea 不会发邮件。

zh-TW.risk: Webhook、鏡像和儲存庫遷移，都會讓伺服器去連使用者指定的位址。
zh-TW.mitigation: Gitea 預設會擋掉指向私有位址的 webhook。範本沒有限制對外連線，想限制的話，請加上 egress NetworkPolicy。範本沒有設定 SMTP 伺服器，所以 Gitea 不會寄信。

risks.risk: The CloudNativePG database instances call the Kubernetes API with an identity that the operator creates.
risks.mitigation: The databases/cloudnative-pg component creates the RBAC permissions for each cluster. The Gitea Pod has no token.

zh-CN.risk: CloudNativePG 的数据库实例会用 operator 创建的身份调用 Kubernetes API。
zh-CN.mitigation: databases/cloudnative-pg 组件会为每个集群创建对应的 RBAC 权限。Gitea 的 Pod 没有 token。

zh-TW.risk: CloudNativePG 的資料庫實例會用 operator 建立的身分呼叫 Kubernetes API。
zh-TW.mitigation: databases/cloudnative-pg 元件會為每個叢集建立對應的 RBAC 權限。Gitea 的 Pod 沒有 token。

risks.risk: Repositories and LFS objects live on the volume, so the database backup does not include them.
risks.mitigation: Back up the gitea-data volume separately, for example with gitea dump. Try a restore before you go to production.

zh-CN.risk: 仓库和 LFS 对象放在卷上，数据库备份不会包含它们。
zh-CN.mitigation: 请另外备份 gitea-data 卷，例如用 gitea dump。正式上线前，先演练一次恢复。

zh-TW.risk: 儲存庫和 LFS 物件放在磁碟區上，資料庫備份不會包含它們。
zh-TW.mitigation: 請另外備份 gitea-data 磁碟區，例如用 gitea dump。正式上線前，先演練一次還原。

scalability.summary: One Gitea instance on a 20Gi volume, with one PostgreSQL primary.
blockers: Repositories, LFS objects, the code indexer and sessions are on a ReadWriteOnce volume. More replicas need shared storage, a shared queue and a shared session store.
A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.

upgradeNotes: Database backups are off when the template is installed. To turn them on, open the database in Zeabur and use the Backups tab.
Back up the database and the gitea-data volume, and keep gitea-secrets, before you change the image digest. Without secret-key, stored two-factor and OAuth secrets cannot be decrypted.
The init container runs gitea migrate before the new version starts. Old and new versions cannot run together. A rollback needs the database backup taken before the upgrade.
Deleting the namespace deletes the volume and the database. Backups in S3 stay.

metadata.name: Halo
metadata.description: Halo publishing with persistent site assets and CloudNativePG PostgreSQL 16.

inputs.name: adminPassword
inputs.description: Generated password of the Halo super administrator admin; retrieve it from Secret halo-secrets, key admin-password.

security.summary: The Halo app runs as non-root with a restricted profile, a read-only root filesystem and no API token. The catalog CloudNativePG operator manages PostgreSQL, and its pods have one exception: a limited service-account token. Outbound traffic is not limited.

zh-CN.summary: Halo 应用以非 root 身份运行，套用受限配置，根文件系统只读，没有 API token。PostgreSQL 由目录里的 CloudNativePG operator 管理，它的 Pod 有一个例外：一个权限受限的服务账号 token。对外连接没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: Halo 應用程式以非 root 身分執行，套用受限設定，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有 API token。PostgreSQL 由目錄裡的 CloudNativePG operator 管理，它的 Pod 有一個例外：一個權限受限的服務帳號 token。對外連線沒有限制。

risks.risk: The CloudNativePG instance manager needs the Kubernetes API and a limited service-account token. The template cannot harden the Pods that the operator creates.
risks.mitigation: Trust the pinned catalog operator. Enforce the restricted Pod Security level on the namespace, and inspect the Pods the operator generates.

zh-CN.risk: CloudNativePG 的 instance manager 需要使用 Kubernetes API 和一个权限受限的服务账号 token。模板没办法直接加固 operator 生成的 Pod。
zh-CN.mitigation: 信任固定版本的目录 operator。在命名空间应用 restricted 级别的 Pod Security，并检查 operator 生成的 Pod。

zh-TW.risk: CloudNativePG 的 instance manager 需要使用 Kubernetes API 和一個權限受限的服務帳號 token。範本沒辦法直接加固 operator 產生的 Pod。
zh-TW.mitigation: 信任固定版本的目錄 operator。在命名空間套用 restricted 等級的 Pod Security，並檢查 operator 產生的 Pod。

risks.risk: If Halo has not been set up yet, the first visitor can create the administrator account.
risks.mitigation: At the first start, the template creates the super administrator admin with a generated password from the Secret halo-secrets, so there is no open setup step. Sign in as admin and change the password in the console.

zh-CN.risk: 如果 Halo 还没完成初始化，第一个来的访客就能创建管理员账号。
zh-CN.mitigation: 第一次启动时，模板会用 halo-secrets 机密里生成的密码创建超级管理员 admin，所以没有开放的设置步骤。请以 admin 登录，并在控制台修改密码。

zh-TW.risk: 如果 Halo 還沒完成初始化，第一個來的訪客就能建立管理員帳號。
zh-TW.mitigation: 第一次啟動時，範本會用 halo-secrets 機密裡產生的密碼建立超級管理員 admin，所以沒有開放的設定步驟。請以 admin 登入，並在控制台改掉密碼。

risks.risk: Database backups do not include Halo's local attachments, plugins or themes.
risks.mitigation: Back up the Halo PVC off the node as well as the database, and test a restore of both together. The built-in Halo backup also stays on the node.

zh-CN.risk: 数据库备份不包含 Halo 的本地附件、插件和主题。
zh-CN.mitigation: 除了数据库，也要把 Halo 的 PVC 备份到节点之外的地方，并测试两者一起恢复。Halo 内置的备份同样只存在节点上。

zh-TW.risk: 資料庫備份不包含 Halo 的本機附件、外掛和主題。
zh-TW.mitigation: 除了資料庫，也要把 Halo 的 PVC 備份到節點以外的地方，並測試兩者一起還原。Halo 內建的備份同樣只存在節點上。

scalability.summary: One writable instance on one volume, with no failover.
blockers: A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.
A single writable application instance is intentional; do not increase replicas without an application-specific storage/database design.
The database runs one PostgreSQL instance. More instances need multi-node replicated storage; a replica count edit alone is not enough.

upgradeNotes: The super administrator admin is created at the first start with the password in halo-secrets/admin-password. The password is used only when no administrator exists, so a restored installation keeps its administrators.
Database backups are off when the template is installed. To turn them on, open the database in Zeabur and use the Backups tab.
Back up persistent application data and its database to storage outside the node before updating the image digest.
Database migrations can be one-way. Restore a copy into a separate namespace and test the upgrade there first: migrations, login, publishing, file access and plugin loading.
Keep PostgreSQL major version 16. The pinned image is PostgreSQL 16.15 on Debian trixie. Upgrade the operator only through the catalog.
Halo keeps its work directory in /var/lib/halo. To move an existing install, copy the contents of its .halo2 directory into this volume. Do not copy the parent /root directory.
CNPG generates halo-db-app credentials; never overwrite or regenerate that Secret during re-render.

security.summary: The pod runs as UID 10000 with no extra capabilities, no privilege escalation and a read-only root filesystem. Only a few paths are writable, and they have size limits. The API needs authentication, and messaging platforms are denied by default. Outbound traffic is not limited.

zh-CN.summary: Pod 以 UID 10000 运行，没有多余的权限，不能提升权限，根文件系统只读。可写入的路径只有少数几个，而且有大小上限。API 需要认证，消息平台默认全部拒绝。对外连接没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: Pod 以 UID 10000 執行，沒有多餘的權限，不能提升權限，根檔案系統唯讀。可寫入的路徑只有少數幾個，而且有大小上限。API 需要驗證，通訊平台預設全部拒絕。對外連線沒有限制。

risks.risk: The agent's tools start subprocesses and run code for highly trusted users.
risks.mitigation: There is no host socket or host path, no privileged mode and no service-account credentials. Outbound traffic is not limited, so agent tasks can reach private and cloud metadata addresses. Add an egress NetworkPolicy to block them. A malicious skill, prompt or web page can take over the agent's state and credentials. Give each trust boundary its own namespace, and use dedicated nodes for users you do not trust.

zh-CN.risk: 代理的工具会启动子进程，并替高度可信的用户运行代码。
zh-CN.mitigation: 没有挂载主机的 socket 或路径，不用特权模式，也没有服务账号凭证。对外连接没有限制，所以代理的任务可以访问私有地址和云端 metadata 地址，请添加 egress NetworkPolicy 拦截它们。恶意的技能、提示词或网页内容，可能接管代理的状态和凭证。每个信任范围请各用一个命名空间，不可信的用户请用专用节点。

zh-TW.risk: 代理的工具會啟動子程序，並替高度受信任的使用者執行程式碼。
zh-TW.mitigation: 沒有掛載主機的 socket 或路徑，不用特權模式，也沒有服務帳號憑證。對外連線沒有限制，所以代理的任務可以連到私有位址和雲端 metadata 位址，請加上 egress NetworkPolicy 擋掉它們。惡意的技能、提示詞或網頁內容，可能接管代理的狀態和憑證。每個信任範圍請各用一個命名空間，不信任的使用者請用專用節點。

risks.risk: The saved state holds provider credentials, conversations, memories and skills that can run code.
risks.mitigation: Allow only one writer, and install only skills you trust. Lazy installs are turned off. Take encrypted backups off the node while the gateway is stopped, and rehearse a restore. After a restore, check file ownership, provider access and the messaging allowlists before you send clients back to it. A node-local StorageClass has no high availability and no snapshots.

zh-CN.risk: 保存的状态里有服务商凭证、对话、记忆，还有能运行代码的技能。
zh-CN.mitigation: 只允许一个写入者，只安装你信任的技能。延迟安装已关闭。在网关停止时，做加密的备份并存到节点之外的地方，也要演练恢复。恢复之后，先检查文件所有者、服务商访问权限和消息白名单，再让客户端连回来。只存在节点本地的 StorageClass 没有高可用，也没有快照。

zh-TW.risk: 保存的狀態裡有服務商憑證、對話、記憶，還有能執行程式碼的技能。
zh-TW.mitigation: 只允許一個寫入者，只安裝你信任的技能。延遲安裝已關閉。在閘道停止時，做加密的備份並存到節點以外的地方，也要演練還原。還原之後，先檢查檔案擁有者、服務商存取權和通訊白名單，再讓用戶端連回來。只存在節點本機的 StorageClass 沒有高可用，也沒有快照。

risks.risk: The dashboard can manage tools, profiles and secrets, so whoever gets in has a lot of power.
risks.mitigation: The Basic-auth password and the session key are generated separately, and the dashboard has its own hostname. Anyone who can reach that hostname can open the dashboard, so keep the generated password private. To limit who can reach it, add an IP limit in the service's network settings.

zh-CN.risk: 仪表板可以管理工具、配置文件和机密，能进去的人权力很大。
zh-CN.mitigation: Basic-auth 密码和会话密钥是分开生成的，仪表板也有自己独立的主机名。任何能访问那个主机名的人都能打开仪表板，所以请保管好生成的密码。想限制谁能访问，请在服务的网络设置里添加 IP 限制。

zh-TW.risk: 儀表板可以管理工具、設定檔和機密，能進去的人權力很大。
zh-TW.mitigation: Basic-auth 密碼和工作階段金鑰是分開產生的，儀表板也有自己獨立的主機名稱。任何連得到那個主機名稱的人都能開啟儀表板，所以請保管好產生的密碼。想限制誰能連進來，請在服務的網路設定裡加上 IP 限制。

risks.risk: The pod does not run the image's s6 /init, because /init needs the DAC_OVERRIDE capability. So the image's first-boot skill setup does not run, and newer versions write a random API_SERVER_KEY to /opt/data/.env.
risks.mitigation: That key overrides the one from hermes-secrets, so API calls with the Secret key may get 401. If that happens, use the API_SERVER_KEY in /opt/data/.env. The bundled skills are not set up.

zh-CN.risk: Pod 不运行镜像的 s6 /init，因为 /init 需要 DAC_OVERRIDE 权限。所以镜像第一次启动时的技能初始化不会跑，而且新版本会把随机的 API_SERVER_KEY 写进 /opt/data/.env。
zh-CN.mitigation: 这个密钥会盖过 hermes-secrets 里的密钥，用 Secret 里的密钥调用 API 可能会得到 401。遇到的话，改用 /opt/data/.env 里的 API_SERVER_KEY。镜像内置的技能不会自动设置。

zh-TW.risk: Pod 不執行映像檔的 s6 /init，因為 /init 需要 DAC_OVERRIDE 權限。所以映像檔第一次啟動時的技能初始化不會跑，而且新版本會把隨機的 API_SERVER_KEY 寫進 /opt/data/.env。
zh-TW.mitigation: 這把金鑰會蓋過 hermes-secrets 裡的金鑰，用 Secret 裡的金鑰呼叫 API 可能會得到 401。遇到的話，改用 /opt/data/.env 裡的 API_SERVER_KEY。映像檔內建的技能不會自動設定。

scalability.summary: One supervised writer with a 10Gi PVC; profile/session state is local to this instance.
blockers: Profile gateways, scheduler, locks and sessions are not distributed shared-nothing state.
A node-local StorageClass has no snapshots or cross-node HA.
Provider quotas and CPU/memory limit concurrent browser/tool subprocesses.

upgradeNotes: The dashboard is open to anyone who can reach adminDomain and signs in with the generated password; add an IP limit in the service's network settings if you need one.
Back up /opt/data consistently before upgrades. Upstream migrates persisted configuration during startup, and an older image may not read migrated state. Roll back by restoring the backup.

The pod does not use the image's /init supervisor. The gateway and the dashboard run as separate containers as UID 10000, which owns /opt/data. After each image update, check that both start without root.
Before the gateway starts, an init container writes the provider, endpoint, key and model into the config. Startup fails when that config is invalid.
The smoke check tests the API listener only. Send one request through the provider to confirm inference.
Keep messaging deny-by-default; configure explicit allowed messaging identities before enabling any external channel. Never restore GATEWAY_ALLOW_ALL_USERS=true.
Only trusted skills/plugins; lazy dependency installation is disabled and application code remains read-only. Integrations that need extra packages need a custom image.

security.summary: The app pods run as non-root with read-only images and no API token. The Percona MongoDB pods use TLS and authentication and stay restricted, with one exception: a writable root filesystem for TLS files that are hardcoded to /tmp. CloudNativePG uses limited tokens that the operator manages. MongoDB requires client certificates. LibreChat presents a 90-day client certificate from the cluster CA, cert-manager renews it, and LibreChat restarts when it changes.

zh-CN.summary: 应用 Pod 以非 root 身份运行，镜像只读，没有 API token。使用 TLS 和认证的 Percona MongoDB Pod 保持受限配置，只有一个例外：根文件系统可写入，因为 TLS 文件写死放在 /tmp。CloudNativePG 使用 operator 管理、权限受限的 token。MongoDB 要求客户端证书。LibreChat 会出示集群 CA 签发、有效期 90 天的客户端证书，由 cert-manager 负责更新，证书一换，LibreChat 就会重启。

zh-TW.summary: 應用程式 Pod 以非 root 身分執行，映像檔唯讀，沒有 API token。使用 TLS 和驗證的 Percona MongoDB Pod 維持受限設定，只有一個例外：根檔案系統可寫入，因為 TLS 檔案寫死放在 /tmp。CloudNativePG 使用 operator 管理、權限受限的 token。MongoDB 要求用戶端憑證。LibreChat 會出示叢集 CA 簽發、有效期 90 天的用戶端憑證，由 cert-manager 負責更新，憑證一換，LibreChat 就會重新啟動。

risks.risk: The Percona v1.23.1 entry scripts write TLS files to the hardcoded paths /tmp/tls.pem and /tmp/tls-internal.pem. The custom resource has no way to mount /tmp separately in the main container.
risks.mitigation: Only the operator-managed pods get this explicit exception, readOnlyRootFilesystem=false. They still require TLS, run as UID 1001, drop all capabilities, allow no escalation and use RuntimeDefault. All ordinary application images stay read-only. Nothing is changed after reconcile, and TLS is never turned off.

zh-CN.risk: Percona v1.23.1 的启动脚本，会把 TLS 文件写到写死的路径 /tmp/tls.pem 和 /tmp/tls-internal.pem。自定义资源也没办法为主容器单独挂载 /tmp。
zh-CN.mitigation: 只有 operator 管理的 Pod 拿到这个明确的例外：readOnlyRootFilesystem=false。它们仍然强制使用 TLS，以 UID 1001 运行，去掉所有额外权限，不允许提升权限，并使用 RuntimeDefault。所有普通应用的镜像都保持只读。协调完成后不会再改动任何东西，TLS 也不会被关掉。

zh-TW.risk: Percona v1.23.1 的啟動腳本，會把 TLS 檔案寫到寫死的路徑 /tmp/tls.pem 和 /tmp/tls-internal.pem。自訂資源也沒辦法替主容器另外掛載 /tmp。
zh-TW.mitigation: 只有 operator 管理的 Pod 拿到這個明確的例外：readOnlyRootFilesystem=false。它們仍然強制使用 TLS，以 UID 1001 執行，拿掉所有額外權限，不允許提升權限，並使用 RuntimeDefault。所有一般應用程式的映像檔都維持唯讀。協調完成後不會再改動任何東西，TLS 也不會被關掉。

risks.risk: The MongoDB server uses the SSPL-1.0 license, which sets duties for anyone who offers MongoDB as a service. SSPL is not OSI-approved.
risks.mitigation: You must acknowledge the exact license when you deploy. The Mongo service is private and reachable only by the app. The Apache-2.0 license of the operator covers only the operator. Meilisearch uses the MIT community image, and the BUSL enterprise modules are not included.

zh-CN.risk: MongoDB 服务器采用 SSPL-1.0 许可，把 MongoDB 作为服务提供给别人的话，要承担额外义务。SSPL 并未通过 OSI 认可。
zh-CN.mitigation: 部署时必须明确确认这份许可。Mongo 服务是私有的，只有应用能访问。operator 的 Apache-2.0 许可只涵盖 operator 本身。Meilisearch 使用 MIT 许可的社区版镜像，不含 BUSL 许可的企业版模块。

zh-TW.risk: MongoDB 伺服器採用 SSPL-1.0 授權，把 MongoDB 當成服務提供給別人的話，要負擔額外義務。SSPL 並未通過 OSI 認可。
zh-TW.mitigation: 部署時必須明確確認這份授權。Mongo 服務是私有的，只有應用程式連得到。operator 的 Apache-2.0 授權只涵蓋 operator 本身。Meilisearch 使用 MIT 授權的社群版映像檔，不含 BUSL 授權的企業版模組。

risks.risk: The CloudNativePG instance manager needs Kubernetes API credentials.
risks.mitigation: The catalog operator creates a service account and RBAC permissions for each cluster. The ordinary app pods and the Percona pods have their tokens turned off.

zh-CN.risk: CloudNativePG 的 instance manager 需要 Kubernetes API 凭证。
zh-CN.mitigation: 目录里的 operator 会为每个集群创建服务账号和 RBAC 权限。普通应用 Pod 和 Percona Pod 的 token 都已停用。

zh-TW.risk: CloudNativePG 的 instance manager 需要 Kubernetes API 憑證。
zh-TW.mitigation: 目錄裡的 operator 會為每個叢集建立服務帳號和 RBAC 權限。一般應用程式 Pod 和 Percona Pod 的 token 都已停用。

risks.risk: Meilisearch has no operator in the catalog. The local files and the databases are also restored from separate points in time.
risks.mitigation: Meilisearch runs as a hardened single-replica StatefulSet. Back up the files, MongoDB, pgvector, Meilisearch dumps and the generated Secrets together. Stop the writers so the file backup is consistent. Test a full restore in an isolated namespace, and check login, saved credentials, search and document retrieval.

zh-CN.risk: Meilisearch 在目录里没有 operator。本地文件和各个数据库的恢复时间点也各不相同。
zh-CN.mitigation: Meilisearch 以加固过的单副本 StatefulSet 运行。文件、MongoDB、pgvector、Meilisearch 转储文件和生成的机密，请一起备份。为了让文件备份一致，备份时要先停掉写入的程序。请在独立的命名空间测试完整恢复，并检查登录、已保存的凭证、搜索和文档检索是否正常。

zh-TW.risk: Meilisearch 在目錄裡沒有 operator。本機檔案和各個資料庫的還原時間點也各不相同。
zh-TW.mitigation: Meilisearch 以加固過的單副本 StatefulSet 執行。檔案、MongoDB、pgvector、Meilisearch 傾印檔和產生的機密，請一起備份。為了讓檔案備份一致，備份時要先停掉寫入的程式。請在獨立的命名空間測試完整還原，並檢查登入、已儲存的憑證、搜尋和文件擷取是否正常。

risks.risk: The app shows the upstream LibreChat privacy policy and terms links.
risks.mitigation: Set your own privacy policy and terms of service before you open the site to the public.

zh-CN.risk: 应用显示的是上游 LibreChat 的隐私政策和服务条款链接。
zh-CN.mitigation: 公开使用之前，请先设置你自己的隐私政策和服务条款。

zh-TW.risk: 應用程式顯示的是上游 LibreChat 的隱私權政策和服務條款連結。
zh-TW.mitigation: 公開使用之前，請先設定你自己的隱私權政策和服務條款。

risks.risk: MongoDB 8.0.32 does not start on Linux kernel 6.19 or newer (SERVER-121912). The template sets GLIBC_TUNABLES as a workaround, and this has not been verified on a real cluster.
risks.mitigation: If MongoDB crashes at start on a new kernel, check that the Percona pods carry GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.pthread.rseq=1.

zh-CN.risk: MongoDB 8.0.32 在 Linux 内核 6.19 以上无法启动（SERVER-121912）。模板设置了 GLIBC_TUNABLES 来绕过，但还没有在真实集群上验证过。
zh-CN.mitigation: 新内核上 MongoDB 一启动就崩溃的话，请确认 Percona Pod 带有 GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.pthread.rseq=1。

zh-TW.risk: MongoDB 8.0.32 在 Linux 核心 6.19 以上無法啟動（SERVER-121912）。範本設定了 GLIBC_TUNABLES 來繞過，但還沒有在真實叢集上驗證過。
zh-TW.mitigation: 新核心上 MongoDB 一啟動就當掉的話，請確認 Percona Pod 有帶 GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.pthread.rseq=1。

scalability.summary: One application/RAG/Meili/PG replica and one operator-managed MongoDB member, like the single CNPG instance. The stack has no HA.
blockers: A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.
MongoDB runs one replica set member (unsafeFlags.replsetSize). Explicit MongoDB FQDNs assume the cluster DNS suffix cluster.local.
Application file PVC, Meili state and pgvector database are single-instance; no app HPA.
Compatible catalog CNPG and Percona operators plus real provider Secrets must exist.

upgradeNotes: Database backups are off when the template is installed. To turn them on, open the database in Zeabur and use the Backups tab.
Back up persistent state off-node before accepting an image digest or schema migration; restore into a separate namespace before cutover.
Keep credsKey, credsIv, the JWT secrets and the database passwords. A new creds key or IV makes stored provider credentials unreadable.
Upgrade the app, RAG API and Meilisearch together and test sign-in, saved credentials, search and RAG. Restoring the previous image does not undo database schema or index migrations.
Meilisearch migrates its database in place at start (MEILI_UPGRADE_DB). The migration is not atomic, so take a snapshot of its volume first.

MongoDB feature-compatibility upgrades and Percona auto-update are off. Keep the operator at CR version 1.23.1 with MongoDB 8.0.32. Change PostgreSQL major versions through a CNPG migration and check pgvector compatibility.

mongod runs with GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.pthread.rseq=1, so TCMalloc uses per-thread caches. Without it, MongoDB 8.0 exits at start on Linux 6.19 to 7.0.13 and on Ubuntu 7.0 kernels (SERVER-121912, SERVER-136848).

This version reduces the MongoDB replica set from three members to one. Back up MongoDB first. The operator removes rs0-1 and rs0-2 and keeps their PVCs. Delete those PVCs after you check the data on rs0-0.

zh-CN.risk: 主密钥可以完整访问代理、代理发出的密钥，以及它保存的服务商凭证。

zh-TW.risk: 主金鑰可以完整存取代理、代理發出的金鑰，以及它保存的服務商憑證。
zh-TW.mitigation: 主金鑰只留給管理用。給應用程式使用的，請發出有預算和模型限制的虛擬金鑰。

risks.risk: Enterprise features need a license from BerriAI.
risks.mitigation: No LITELLM_LICENSE is set, so enterprise features stay off. Because the enterprise code ships in the image, the person who installs the template must accept the enterprise license.

zh-CN.risk: 企业版功能需要 BerriAI 的许可。
zh-CN.mitigation: 模板没有设置 LITELLM_LICENSE，所以企业版功能是关闭的。因为企业版代码包含在镜像里，安装模板的人必须接受企业版许可。

zh-TW.risk: 企業版功能需要 BerriAI 的授權。
zh-TW.mitigation: 範本沒有設定 LITELLM_LICENSE，所以企業版功能是關閉的。因為企業版程式碼包含在映像檔裡，安裝範本的人必須接受企業版授權。

risks.risk: The CloudNativePG database instances call the Kubernetes API with an identity that the operator creates.
risks.mitigation: The databases/cloudnative-pg component creates the RBAC permissions for each cluster. The LiteLLM Pod has no token.

zh-CN.risk: CloudNativePG 的数据库实例会用 operator 创建的身份调用 Kubernetes API。
zh-CN.mitigation: databases/cloudnative-pg 组件会为每个集群创建对应的 RBAC 权限。LiteLLM 的 Pod 没有 token。

zh-TW.risk: CloudNativePG 的資料庫實例會用 operator 建立的身分呼叫 Kubernetes API。
zh-TW.mitigation: databases/cloudnative-pg 元件會為每個叢集建立對應的 RBAC 權限。LiteLLM 的 Pod 沒有 token。

scalability.summary: One LiteLLM instance with one PostgreSQL primary.
blockers: LiteLLM migrates the database at start, and rate limits and caches are per process. More replicas need Redis and the migration moved to a separate step.

upgradeNotes: Database backups are off when the template is installed. To turn them on, open the database in Zeabur and use the Backups tab.
LiteLLM migrates the database on start. A rollback needs the database backup taken before the upgrade.
Keep litellm-secrets. Without salt-key, stored provider credentials cannot be decrypted.
Deleting the namespace deletes the database. Backups in S3 stay.

zh-CN.mitigation: 模板说明里有写明许可证。模板运行的是未经修改的镜像，声明都完整保留。要分发衍生作品之前，请先取得商业授权许可。

zh-TW.risk: LobeHub 社群授權限制你散布衍生作品的方式。
zh-TW.mitigation: 範本說明裡有寫明授權。範本執行的是未經修改的映像檔，聲明都完整保留。要散布衍生作品之前，請先取得商業授權許可。

risks.risk: Everyone who knows the shared access code uses the same instance and the same model key, and the server pays for it.
risks.mitigation: Share a deployment only with users who trust each other. The code is generated with high entropy, the upstream sign-in protection is on, and ingress allows TLS only.

zh-CN.risk: 知道共用访问码的人，都会共用同一个实例和同一把模型密钥，费用由服务器这边承担。
zh-CN.mitigation: 只把部署分享给彼此信任的用户。访问码是高强度随机生成的，上游的登录保护已开启，Ingress 只允许 TLS 连接。

zh-TW.risk: 知道共用存取碼的人，都會共用同一個實例和同一把模型金鑰，費用由伺服器這邊負擔。
zh-TW.mitigation: 只把部署分享給彼此信任的使用者。存取碼是高強度隨機產生的，上游的登入保護已開啟，Ingress 只允許 TLS 連線。

scalability.summary: One instance per trusted owner; do not horizontally scale this deployment.
blockers: Chats are browser-local and the access code is shared. The deployment has no multi-tenant backend.

upgradeNotes: This template runs LobeChat 1.143.3 in client-storage mode. LobeHub server mode uses different database, identity and storage. Do not switch the image to server mode without migrating user data and authentication.
Unmodified upstream image only. The license is named in the template description; derivative-work distribution needs upstream commercial permission.

Access code is generated; use the UI settings to supply it. Chats live in each browser. Export and import browser data for backups. Keep the access-code and provider Secrets in an encrypted external backup.
Before updates, check release notes, license changes and browser data migrations. Test import and rollback with exported histories. The runtime cache is disposable.

zh-TW.summary: 以 UID 1000 執行，檔案系統唯讀，沒有 Kubernetes 權杖，也拿掉了所有額外的系統權限。正式模式一定要有主金鑰。Ingress 路由是公開的。

risks.risk: Anyone on the internet can reach the API through the Ingress.
risks.mitigation: Without a valid key, Meilisearch rejects requests. The search preview page is off. Give browsers only a search key or a tenant token. Never give them the master key.

zh-CN.risk: 任何人都能从网络访问 Ingress 上的 API。
zh-CN.mitigation: 没有有效密钥的请求都会被拒绝，搜索预览页面也已关闭。给浏览器的只能是搜索密钥或租户令牌，千万不要把主密钥给它。

zh-TW.risk: 任何人都能從網路連到 Ingress 上的 API。
zh-TW.mitigation: 沒有有效金鑰的請求都會被拒絕，搜尋預覽頁面也已關閉。給瀏覽器的只能是搜尋金鑰或租戶權杖，千萬不要把主金鑰給它。

risks.risk: AI-powered search embedders, webhooks and network search make outbound calls, and the template does not limit them. Someone could point one at a private address.
risks.mitigation: Set up only provider endpoints you trust. You can also add an egress NetworkPolicy (a rule that limits outbound traffic) to restrict them.

zh-CN.risk: AI 搜索的嵌入服务、webhook 和网络搜索都会对外连接，模板没有限制。有人可能把其中一个设置指向内部的私有地址。
zh-CN.mitigation: 只设置你信任的服务商地址。也可以加一条 egress NetworkPolicy（限制对外连接的规则）来限制。

zh-TW.risk: AI 搜尋的嵌入服務、webhook 和網路搜尋都會對外連線，範本沒有限制。有人可能把其中一個設定指向內部的私有位址。
zh-TW.mitigation: 只設定你信任的服務商位址。也可以加一條 egress NetworkPolicy（限制對外連線的規則）來限制。

risks.risk: Enterprise Edition features are not in this image.
risks.mitigation: Sharding, replication and S3 snapshots return a requires_enterprise_edition error. They need the separate Enterprise image, which uses the BUSL-1.1 license and needs a commercial license for production use.

zh-CN.risk: 这个镜像不含企业版功能。
zh-CN.mitigation: 分片、复制和 S3 快照会返回 requires_enterprise_edition 错误。要用这些功能得另外使用企业版镜像，它采用 BUSL-1.1 许可，生产环境使用要买商业许可。

zh-TW.risk: 這個映像檔不含企業版功能。
zh-TW.mitigation: 分片、複寫和 S3 快照會回傳 requires_enterprise_edition 錯誤。要用這些功能得另外使用企業版映像檔，它採用 BUSL-1.1 授權，正式環境使用要買商業授權。

scalability.summary: One instance on a 20Gi volume. Indexing uses at most 1 GiB of memory.
blockers: Each instance keeps its own LMDB indexes on its volume. Replication needs the Enterprise Edition.
A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.

upgradeNotes: Create a dump with POST /dumps and copy it off the node before you change the image digest. Dumps are the supported path between versions.
Meilisearch migrates the database on start for most upgrades. Read the release notes for each version in between; some need a dump import. A rollback needs the dump taken before the upgrade.
The master key in meilisearch-secrets protects all derived API keys. If you rotate it, every API key changes.
Deleting the namespace deletes the PVC and all indexes.

metadata.name: Memos
metadata.description: Memos note-taking service with SQLite on a persistent volume and a provisioned administrator.

inputs.name: adminPassword
inputs.description: Password of the administrator account admin, created at the first start. Change it in Memos after you sign in; the Secret is not applied again.

security.summary: The container runs as UID 10001 with a read-only filesystem, no Kubernetes token and all extra system privileges removed. Outbound traffic is not limited. Public sign-up is off.

zh-CN.summary: 以 UID 10001 运行，文件系统只读，没有 Kubernetes 令牌，也去掉了所有额外的系统权限。对外连接没有限制。公开注册已关闭。

zh-TW.summary: 以 UID 10001 執行，檔案系統唯讀，沒有 Kubernetes 權杖，也拿掉了所有額外的系統權限。對外連線沒有限制。公開註冊已關閉。

risks.risk: On an empty instance, the first account created becomes the administrator.
risks.mitigation: A postStart hook creates the account admin with the generated password before the Pod becomes ready. If the hook fails, Kubernetes restarts the container and the Pod receives no traffic.

zh-CN.risk: 全新的实例上，第一个创建的账号会变成管理员。
zh-CN.mitigation: Pod 就绪之前，postStart hook 会先用自动生成的密码创建 admin 账号。如果 hook 失败，Kubernetes 会重启容器，Pod 也不会收到任何流量。

zh-TW.risk: 全新的實例上，第一個建立的帳號會變成管理員。
zh-TW.mitigation: Pod 準備好之前，postStart hook 會先用自動產生的密碼建立 admin 帳號。如果 hook 失敗，Kubernetes 會重啟容器，Pod 也不會收到任何流量。

risks.risk: Anyone could register an account.
risks.mitigation: The memos-settings ConfigMap turns on disallowUserRegistration. The administrator creates accounts in Settings. This ConfigMap controls the general settings, so to change them, edit the ConfigMap and restart the Pod.

zh-CN.risk: 任何人都可能自己注册账号。
zh-CN.mitigation: ConfigMap memos-settings 已开启 disallowUserRegistration。账号由管理员在设置里创建。常规设置由这个 ConfigMap 管，要改的话请编辑它，再重启 Pod。

zh-TW.risk: 任何人都可能自己註冊帳號。
zh-TW.mitigation: ConfigMap memos-settings 已開啟 disallowUserRegistration。帳號由管理員在設定裡建立。一般設定由這個 ConfigMap 管，要改的話請編輯它，再重啟 Pod。

risks.risk: Webhooks and link previews make the server request addresses that users choose.
risks.mitigation: Memos blocks private webhook targets by default. The template does not limit outbound traffic. To limit it, add an egress NetworkPolicy (a rule that limits outbound traffic).

zh-CN.risk: Webhook 和链接预览会让服务器去访问用户指定的地址。
zh-CN.mitigation: Memos 默认会拦掉指向私有地址的 webhook。模板没有限制对外连接，想限制的话，请加一条 egress NetworkPolicy（限制对外连接的规则）。

zh-TW.risk: Webhook 和連結預覽會讓伺服器去連使用者指定的位址。
zh-TW.mitigation: Memos 預設會擋掉指向私有位址的 webhook。範本沒有限制對外連線，想限制的話，請加一條 egress NetworkPolicy（限制對外連線的規則）。

scalability.summary: One instance with SQLite on a 10Gi volume.
blockers: SQLite allows one writer. More replicas need MySQL or PostgreSQL.
A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.

upgradeNotes: Stop Memos and copy /var/opt/memos (the SQLite database and local attachments) off the node before you change the image digest.
Memos migrates the database on start. Read the release notes for each version in between. A rollback needs the copy taken before the upgrade.
Deleting the namespace deletes the PVC with all memos and attachments.

inputs.name: adminPassword

security.summary: The container runs as UID 65534 with a read-only filesystem, no Kubernetes token and all extra system privileges removed. Outbound traffic is not limited. After installation, only the admin user exists.

zh-CN.summary: 以 UID 65534 运行，文件系统只读，没有 Kubernetes 令牌，也去掉了所有额外的系统权限。对外连接没有限制。安装完只有 admin 一个用户。

zh-TW.summary: 以 UID 65534 執行，檔案系統唯讀，沒有 Kubernetes 權杖，也拿掉了所有額外的系統權限。對外連線沒有限制。安裝完只有 admin 一個使用者。

risks.risk: The server fetches feeds from addresses that users choose.
risks.mitigation: Miniflux refuses private network addresses by default. The template does not limit outbound traffic. To limit it, add an egress NetworkPolicy (a rule that limits outbound traffic).

zh-CN.risk: 服务器会去抓取用户指定地址的订阅源。
zh-CN.mitigation: Miniflux 默认会拒绝私有网络地址。模板没有限制对外连接，想限制的话，请加一条 egress NetworkPolicy（限制对外连接的规则）。

zh-TW.risk: 伺服器會去抓使用者指定位址的訂閱源。
zh-TW.mitigation: Miniflux 預設會拒絕私有網路位址。範本沒有限制對外連線，想限制的話，請加一條 egress NetworkPolicy（限制對外連線的規則）。

risks.risk: The database pods (CloudNativePG) call the Kubernetes API with an identity that the database operator creates.
risks.mitigation: The databases/cloudnative-pg component creates separate permissions for each database cluster. The Miniflux Pod has no token.

zh-CN.risk: 数据库 Pod（CloudNativePG）会用数据库 operator 创建的身份去调用 Kubernetes API。
zh-CN.mitigation: databases/cloudnative-pg 组件会为每个数据库集群各建一组权限。Miniflux 的 Pod 没有令牌。

zh-TW.risk: 資料庫 Pod（CloudNativePG）會用資料庫 operator 建立的身分去呼叫 Kubernetes API。
zh-TW.mitigation: databases/cloudnative-pg 元件會為每個資料庫叢集各建一組權限。Miniflux 的 Pod 沒有權杖。

scalability.summary: One Miniflux instance with one PostgreSQL primary.
blockers: Each instance runs its own feed scheduler. More replicas need the scheduler disabled on all but one instance.

upgradeNotes: Database backups are off when the template is installed. To turn them on, open the database in Zeabur and use the Backups tab.
Miniflux migrates the database on start. A rollback needs the database backup taken before the upgrade.
Deleting the namespace deletes the database. Backups in S3 stay.

inputs.name: ownerEmail

inputs.label: Owner email

inputs.description: Deploy-time random secret; preserve it across upgrades.

security.summary: Everything runs in its own namespace. Images are pinned by digest and workloads run as non-root users. Network access is kept to the minimum. There are no default passwords.

zh-CN.summary: 所有东西都在自己的命名空间里运行。镜像以 digest 固定版本，工作负载都用非 root 用户运行，网络访问压到最低，也没有默认密码。

zh-TW.summary: 所有東西都在自己的命名空間裡執行。映像檔以 digest 固定版本，工作負載都用非 root 使用者執行，網路存取壓到最低，也沒有預設密碼。

risks.risk: n8n uses the Sustainable Use License. You can read the source, but it is not OSI-approved open source. Enterprise files have separate terms.
risks.mitigation: The template description names the license. Deploy only for permitted internal business, personal or noncommercial use. To resell hosted n8n, you need a separate agreement with n8n.

zh-CN.risk: n8n 用的是 Sustainable Use License。源码看得到，但不算 OSI 认可的开源许可。企业版文件另有条款。
zh-CN.mitigation: 模板说明里有写明许可。只能用在允许的范围：公司内部业务、个人或非商业用途。想把 n8n 当托管服务转售，要另外跟 n8n 签约。

zh-TW.risk: n8n 用的是 Sustainable Use License。原始碼看得到，但不算 OSI 認可的開源授權。企業版檔案另有條款。
zh-TW.mitigation: 範本說明裡有寫明授權。只能用在允許的範圍：公司內部業務、個人或非商業用途。想把 n8n 當託管服務轉賣，要另外跟 n8n 簽約。

risks.risk: Workflow authors can call outside providers, install code or build powerful integrations.
risks.mitigation: Only let trusted people be administrators. The task runner (the part that runs workflow code) is isolated, has no Kubernetes token and has a read-only filesystem. It cannot read environment variables. The dangerous executeCommand and localFileTrigger nodes are removed. Outbound traffic is not limited, so add an egress NetworkPolicy (a rule that limits outbound traffic) to keep workflows away from private addresses. Community package tools are enabled, so administrators must check each package they install.

zh-CN.risk: 工作流的作者可以调用外部服务、安装代码，或做出权限很大的集成。
zh-CN.mitigation: 管理员只给信任的人。任务执行器（运行工作流代码的部分）是隔离的，没有 Kubernetes 令牌，文件系统只读，也读不到环境变量。危险的 executeCommand 和 localFileTrigger 节点已经移除。对外连接没有限制，所以请加一条 egress NetworkPolicy（限制对外连接的规则），让工作流连不到私有地址。社区包工具是开启的，管理员要自己检查每个安装的包。

zh-TW.risk: 工作流程的作者可以呼叫外部服務、安裝程式碼，或做出權限很大的整合。
zh-TW.mitigation: 管理員只給信任的人。任務執行器（跑工作流程程式碼的部分）是隔離的，沒有 Kubernetes 權杖，檔案系統唯讀，也讀不到環境變數。危險的 executeCommand 和 localFileTrigger 節點已經移除。對外連線沒有限制，所以請加一條 egress NetworkPolicy（限制對外連線的規則），讓工作流程連不到私有位址。社群套件工具是開啟的，管理員要自己檢查每個安裝的套件。

risks.risk: On a public instance that is not set up yet, the first visitor could claim the owner account.
risks.mitigation: The template uses the managed-owner variables (n8n v2.17 and later). A bcrypt hash (a one-way scrambled form) of the generated Secret is set before n8n starts. The deployment variables set the owner email and password again at each restart. Public sign-up stays closed.

zh-CN.risk: 公开的实例如果还没设置好，第一个来的访客就能抢走所有者账号。
zh-CN.mitigation: 模板用的是 n8n v2.17 以后支持的托管所有者变量。n8n 启动前，就先把自动生成的机密做成 bcrypt 哈希（单向打乱的形式）设好。每次重启，部署变量都会再设置一次所有者的邮箱和密码。公开注册保持关闭。

zh-TW.risk: 公開的實例如果還沒設定好，第一個來的訪客就能搶走擁有者帳號。
zh-TW.mitigation: 範本用的是 n8n v2.17 以後支援的託管擁有者變數。n8n 啟動前，就先把自動產生的機密做成 bcrypt 雜湊（單向打亂的形式）設好。每次重啟，部署變數都會再設定一次擁有者的 Email 和密碼。公開註冊維持關閉。

risks.risk: The database pods (CloudNativePG) must call the Kubernetes API with an identity that the database operator creates.
risks.mitigation: The databases/cloudnative-pg component creates separate permissions for each database cluster. This exception never applies to the n8n and task-runner Pods.

zh-CN.risk: 数据库 Pod（CloudNativePG）必须用数据库 operator 创建的身份去调用 Kubernetes API。
zh-CN.mitigation: databases/cloudnative-pg 组件会为每个数据库集群各建一组权限。这个例外绝不会用在 n8n 和任务执行器的 Pod 上。

zh-TW.risk: 資料庫 Pod（CloudNativePG）必須用資料庫 operator 建立的身分去呼叫 Kubernetes API。
zh-TW.mitigation: databases/cloudnative-pg 元件會為每個資料庫叢集各建一組權限。這個例外絕不會套用到 n8n 和任務執行器的 Pod。

risks.risk: No SMTP server is configured.
risks.mitigation: Email invitations and password-reset mail do not work until you configure SMTP in n8n.

zh-CN.risk: 没有设置 SMTP 服务器。
zh-CN.mitigation: 你在 n8n 里设置好 SMTP 之前，邀请邮件和重置密码邮件都发不出去。

zh-TW.risk: 沒有設定 SMTP 伺服器。
zh-TW.mitigation: 你在 n8n 裡設定好 SMTP 之前，邀請信和重設密碼信都寄不出去。

scalability.summary: Single-writer deployment; no automatic horizontal scaling.
blockers: A node-local default StorageClass has no HA or snapshots.
Filesystem binary-data storage has a single writer; execution queue mode and shared binary store are not configured.
One PostgreSQL primary and one n8n main; scaling requires queue mode, Redis and shared binary storage.

upgradeNotes: Database backups are off when the template is installed. To turn them on, open the database in Zeabur and use the Backups tab.
Preserve Secrets and PVCs. Back up data off-node and rehearse a restore before changing image digests.
Main n8n and runner must remain exactly 2.44.6 together; never upgrade one side independently. Preserve encryption key, runner token, database, binary files and owner password across upgrades.
Image rollback does not undo n8n database migrations; restore the backup taken before the upgrade.

Data lives in /home/node/.n8n. The runner token is a random Secret. Settings-file permissions are enforced, node environment reads are blocked, and the executeCommand and localFileTrigger nodes are disabled.
GENERIC_TIMEZONE is Asia/Taipei. Change it in the manifest if schedule triggers must use another timezone.

Owner email/password is controlled by deployment variables. Rotate n8n-secrets/owner-password and restart to change password; recover encryption-key from secure backups, never regenerate it for an existing database.
