risks.mitigation: The attachment cache is limited to 2G in total and 15M per file. The message cache keeps 12 hours of messages.

zh-CN.risk: 附件会占用存储卷的磁盘空间。
zh-CN.mitigation: 附件缓存总共最多 2G，单个文件最多 15M。消息缓存只保留 12 小时的消息。

zh-TW.risk: 附件會佔用儲存空間的磁碟。
zh-TW.mitigation: 附件快取總共最多 2G，單一檔案最多 15M。訊息快取只保留 12 小時的訊息。

scalability.summary: One instance with SQLite on a 5Gi volume.
blockers: Subscribers hold connections to one process, and the caches are SQLite files. More replicas need PostgreSQL and the experimental cluster mode.
A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.

upgradeNotes: Copy user.db off the node before you change the image digest. It holds users, access rules and tokens. cache.db and attachments are temporary.
ntfy migrates its databases on start. A rollback needs the copy taken before the upgrade.
Deleting the namespace deletes the PVC, users and cached messages.

metadata.name: Ollama
metadata.description: Private CPU-only local model runtime. The API has no public ingress.

security.summary: The container runs as UID 1000 with no extra system privileges and a read-only image. The API has no sign-in. Only clients in the same namespace that carry a specific label can reach it.

zh-CN.summary: 以 UID 1000 运行，没有额外的系统权限，镜像只读。API 没有登录验证，只有同一个命名空间里、带有指定标签的客户端连得到。

zh-TW.summary: 以 UID 1000 執行，沒有額外的系統權限，映像檔唯讀。API 沒有登入驗證，只有同一個命名空間裡、帶有指定標籤的用戶端連得到。

risks.risk: The Ollama API has no sign-in, and anyone who can reach it can manage models.
risks.mitigation: There is no Ingress or NodePort. Only trusted pods in this namespace that carry the label templates.zeabur.com/ollama-client=true can connect. Do not attach a public route to this service, because it has no sign-in.

zh-CN.risk: Ollama API 没有登录验证，连得到的人都能管理模型。
zh-CN.mitigation: 没有 Ingress 也没有 NodePort。只有这个命名空间里、带有标签 templates.zeabur.com/ollama-client=true 的可信 Pod 连得进来。不要给这个服务加公开路由，因为它没有登录验证。

zh-TW.risk: Ollama API 沒有登入驗證，連得到的人都能管理模型。
zh-TW.mitigation: 沒有 Ingress 也沒有 NodePort。只有這個命名空間裡、帶有標籤 templates.zeabur.com/ollama-client=true 的可信任 Pod 連得進來。不要幫這個服務加公開路由，因為它沒有登入驗證。

risks.risk: Each model has its own license, separate from the MIT license of the Ollama software. Model files can also use up all your RAM and disk.
risks.mitigation: No model is preloaded. Read each model's license and check its size, then run `ollama pull MODEL` in the Pod. The Pod loads one model and serves one request at a time. It has an 8Gi memory limit and a 50Gi volume, so most large models do not fit.

zh-CN.risk: 每个模型都有自己的许可，跟 Ollama 软件本身的 MIT 许可无关。模型文件也可能把内存和磁盘用光。
zh-CN.mitigation: 不会预先加载任何模型。请先看过每个模型的许可和大小，再到 Pod 里运行 `ollama pull MODEL`。Pod 一次只加载一个模型，一次只处理一个请求。内存上限是 8Gi，存储卷是 50Gi，所以多数大型模型放不下。

zh-TW.risk: 每個模型都有自己的授權，跟 Ollama 軟體本身的 MIT 授權無關。模型檔也可能把記憶體和磁碟吃光。
zh-TW.mitigation: 不會預先載入任何模型。請先看過每個模型的授權和大小，再到 Pod 裡執行 `ollama pull MODEL`。Pod 一次只載入一個模型，一次只處理一個請求。記憶體上限是 8Gi，儲存空間是 50Gi，所以多數大型模型放不下。

scalability.summary: Single replica on one volume, with no failover.
blockers: A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.
Replicas cannot share the model store. More replicas need a shared volume.
Inference runs on CPU only. The template does not schedule GPUs.

upgradeNotes: Back up persistent state off-node before accepting an image digest or schema migration; restore into a separate namespace before cutover.

To back up, stop writes and copy /data to encrypted off-node storage. Include private model definitions and private keys, as well as public model blobs. Keep the previous digest and a compatible data copy for rollback.
The Deployment uses the Recreate strategy. The API is unavailable during an upgrade.

metadata.name: Open WebUI
metadata.description: Authenticated LLM interface with private pipelines. Open WebUI's license (https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/blob/main/LICENSE) requires you to keep its branding.

inputs.name: adminEmail
inputs.description: Initial administrator email; password is generated in app-secrets/admin-password.
inputs.label: Administrator email

zh-CN.label: 管理员邮箱
zh-CN.description: 第一个管理员的邮箱。密码会自动生成，放在机密 app-secrets 的 admin-password。

zh-TW.label: 管理員 Email
zh-TW.description: 第一個管理員的 Email。密碼會自動產生，放在機密 app-secrets 的 admin-password。

inputs.name: adminPassword
inputs.description: adminPassword generated credential; retain during upgrades.

inputs.name: sessionKey
inputs.description: sessionKey generated credential; retain during upgrades.

inputs.name: pipelineKey
inputs.description: pipelineKey generated credential; retain during upgrades.

security.summary: The web interface and the pipeline service both run as UID 1000 with no extra system privileges and read-only images. The first admin credentials and the pipeline API key are generated. Sign-up is disabled.

zh-CN.summary: 网页界面和 pipeline 服务都以 UID 1000 运行，没有额外的系统权限，镜像只读。第一组管理员账号密码和 pipeline API 密钥都是自动生成的。注册功能已关闭。

zh-TW.summary: 網頁介面和 pipeline 服務都以 UID 1000 執行，沒有額外的系統權限，映像檔唯讀。第一組管理員帳密和 pipeline API 金鑰都是自動產生的。註冊功能已關閉。

risks.risk: Open WebUI uses a custom license. You can read the source, but it is not OSI-approved, and it has branding rules.
risks.mitigation: The template description names the license. Keep all the upstream branding. Section 4 allows branding changes only for at most 50 end users in a rolling 30-day period, or with written or enterprise permission. This template keeps the upstream branding.

zh-CN.risk: Open WebUI 用的是自定义许可。源码看得到，但不算 OSI 认可，而且对品牌标识有规定。
zh-CN.mitigation: 模板说明里有写明许可。请保留上游所有的品牌标识。第 4 节只允许在 30 天内最多 50 位终端用户的情况下改品牌，或是取得书面或企业授权。这个模板保留了上游的品牌标识。

zh-TW.risk: Open WebUI 用的是自訂授權。原始碼看得到，但不算 OSI 認可，而且對品牌標示有規定。
zh-TW.mitigation: 範本說明裡有寫明授權。請保留上游所有的品牌標示。第 4 節只允許在 30 天內最多 50 位終端使用者的情況下改品牌，或是取得書面或企業授權。這個範本保留了上游的品牌標示。

risks.risk: Pipelines and tools added by administrators run Python code with access to provider credentials.
risks.mitigation: Treat every installed pipeline and dependency as application code and trust it fully. Keep the pipeline service private so only the web interface can reach it. It has no Kubernetes tokens or host sockets. Outbound traffic is not limited, so add an egress NetworkPolicy (a rule that limits outbound traffic) to keep pipelines away from private addresses. Python packages install to the writable pipeline volume. Packages that need root (apt or system libraries for a browser) cannot install at runtime. Build them into your own pinned image.

zh-CN.risk: Pipeline 和管理员添加的工具会运行 Python 代码，而且拿得到服务商的凭据。
zh-CN.mitigation: 每个安装的 pipeline 和依赖包，都要当成应用代码，完全信任了才装。pipeline 服务要保持私有，只让网页界面连得到。它没有 Kubernetes 令牌，也没有主机 socket。对外连接没有限制，所以请加一条 egress NetworkPolicy（限制对外连接的规则），让 pipeline 连不到私有地址。Python 包会装到可写入的 pipeline 存储卷。需要 root 的包（apt 或浏览器用的系统库）无法在运行时安装，请自己打包进固定版本的镜像。

zh-TW.risk: Pipeline 和管理員加的工具會執行 Python 程式碼，而且拿得到服務商的憑證。
zh-TW.mitigation: 每個安裝的 pipeline 和相依套件，都要當成應用程式的程式碼，完全信任了才裝。pipeline 服務要保持私有，只讓網頁介面連得到。它沒有 Kubernetes 權杖，也沒有主機 socket。對外連線沒有限制，所以請加一條 egress NetworkPolicy（限制對外連線的規則），讓 pipeline 連不到私有位址。Python 套件會裝到可寫入的 pipeline 儲存空間。需要 root 的套件（apt 或瀏覽器用的系統函式庫）無法在執行時安裝，請自己打包進固定版本的映像檔。

risks.risk: External model providers receive your chat content and the data from documents you upload.
risks.mitigation: Read each provider's privacy terms before you connect it. Ollama is disabled. Add provider connections in the admin settings.

zh-CN.risk: 外部的模型服务商会收到你的对话内容和上传文档的数据。
zh-CN.mitigation: 连接每个服务商之前，请先读过它的隐私条款。Ollama 已停用，服务商的连接请到管理员设置里自己加。

zh-TW.risk: 外部的模型服務商會收到你的對話內容和上傳文件的資料。
zh-TW.mitigation: 連接每個服務商之前，請先讀過它的隱私條款。Ollama 已停用，服務商的連線請到管理員設定裡自己加。

scalability.summary: Single replica with persistent storage. The template has no high availability.
blockers: A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.
The UI stores data in SQLite on its volume; the pipeline volume holds installed pipeline code and packages. Neither supports more than one writer.

upgradeNotes: Back up persistent state off-node before accepting an image digest or schema migration; restore into a separate namespace before cutover.

Stop both Deployments, then back up the UI volume, the pipeline volume and app-secrets together. Keep the previous image digest pair; UI schema migrations and pipeline dependency changes can prevent rollback.
Keep app-secrets/session-key (WEBUI_SECRET_KEY). A new value signs out all users.
ENABLE_PERSISTENT_CONFIG is false. Settings from the manifest environment apply again at each restart.
A change of embedding model requires you to re-embed stored documents.
Both images pin a digest of the upstream main branch. Read the upstream changes and the license before you move to a newer digest.

metadata.name: OpenClaw
metadata.description: OpenClaw (formerly Clawdbot, Moltbot) is a personal AI assistant that runs locally and connects to multiple messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, etc.) via a WebSocket-based Gateway architecture.

inputs.name: gatewayToken
inputs.description: Generated gateway-token; retrieve from Secret openclaw-secrets, never from a public URL.

inputs.name: providerSecret
inputs.description: Pre-existing Secret in this namespace containing the model provider API key in key api-key.
inputs.label: Provider API key secret

zh-CN.label: 模型服务 API 密钥的机密
zh-CN.description: 这个项目里现有的机密，键 api-key 放模型服务的 API 密钥。

zh-TW.label: 模型服務 API 金鑰的機密
zh-TW.description: 這個專案裡現有的機密，鍵 api-key 放模型服務的 API 金鑰。

inputs.name: llmBaseUrl
inputs.description: OpenAI-compatible HTTPS API base URL; public network on TCP 443 only.
inputs.label: API base URL

zh-CN.label: API 地址
zh-CN.description: OpenAI 兼容的 HTTPS API 地址，只能是公网上的 TCP 443。

zh-TW.label: API 網址
zh-TW.description: OpenAI 相容的 HTTPS API 網址，只能是公開網路上的 TCP 443。

inputs.name: llmModel
inputs.description: Model identifier for the configured compatible provider.
inputs.label: Model

zh-CN.label: 模型
zh-CN.description: 模型服务上的模型名称。

zh-TW.label: 模型
zh-TW.description: 模型服務上的模型名稱。

security.summary: OpenClaw runs without root rights, with a read-only root filesystem, the strictest Kubernetes pod security profile and no Kubernetes token. Traffic comes in over HTTPS. Outbound traffic is not limited.

zh-CN.summary: OpenClaw 不用 root 权限运行，根文件系统只读，应用最严格的 Kubernetes Pod 安全设置，也没有 Kubernetes token。对外连接一律走 HTTPS。向外的网络流量没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: OpenClaw 不用 root 權限執行，根檔案系統唯讀，套用最嚴格的 Kubernetes Pod 安全設定，也沒有 Kubernetes token。對外連線一律走 HTTPS。往外的網路流量沒有限制。

risks.risk: The AI assistant can run commands and read everything its pod can reach, including its state and model credentials. Pod security settings do not stop prompt injection, where a hostile message tricks the assistant into acting.
risks.mitigation: Use one trusted owner per namespace and gateway. The pod has no host mounts, no service-account token and no Docker socket, and its resources are limited. Do not share it with users you do not trust.

zh-CN.risk: AI 助理可以执行命令，也能读到它的 Pod 碰得到的所有东西，包括状态数据和模型的凭证。Pod 的安全设置挡不住提示注入，也就是有人用恶意消息骗助理去做事。
zh-CN.mitigation: 每个命名空间和网关只给一位可信任的所有者使用。Pod 没有挂载主机目录，没有 service-account token，也没有 Docker socket，资源也有上限。不要分享给你不信任的人。

zh-TW.risk: AI 助理可以執行指令，也能讀到它的 Pod 碰得到的所有東西，包括狀態資料和模型的憑證。Pod 的安全設定擋不住提示注入，也就是有人用惡意訊息騙助理去做事。
zh-TW.mitigation: 每個命名空間和閘道只給一位可信任的擁有者使用。Pod 沒有掛載主機目錄，沒有 service-account token，也沒有 Docker socket，資源也有上限。不要分享給你不信任的人。

risks.risk: The agent's state and channel credentials are stored together on one PVC (one data volume).
risks.mitigation: Stop writes, then make encrypted backups outside the cluster of the whole PVC, the gateway Secret and the provider Secret. A node-local StorageClass has no high availability and no volume snapshots.

zh-CN.risk: 代理程序的状态和频道凭证都放在同一个 PVC（一个数据卷）里。
zh-CN.mitigation: 先停止写入，再把整个 PVC、网关机密和供应商机密做加密备份，存到集群外面。节点本地的 StorageClass 没有高可用，也不能做卷快照。

zh-TW.risk: 代理程式的狀態和頻道憑證都放在同一個 PVC（一個資料磁碟區）裡。
zh-TW.mitigation: 先停止寫入，再把整個 PVC、閘道機密和供應商機密做加密備份，存到叢集外面。節點本機的 StorageClass 沒有高可用，也不能做磁碟區快照。

scalability.summary: One instance per trusted owner; do not horizontally scale this deployment.
blockers: Single-owner gateway and persistent state on one volume.

upgradeNotes: Back up the complete openclaw-home PVC and generated gateway-token Secret before changing the pinned image.
Configuration is seeded only on first start; edit persisted configuration through the Control UI or CLI. Changing provider inputs does not overwrite existing user configuration.
Use https://<domain> and the generated token; approve device pairing with the CLI inside the pod. Never put the token in a public URL.

Config schema and pairing behaviour change quickly. Read the upstream migration notes before each upgrade. Restoring the PVC with the old image rolls back only when the new version did not migrate data one-way.
Readiness uses /startupz and liveness uses /healthz. /readyz depends on channels and can stay false until you configure one.
No runtime Homebrew/Go installs, Docker socket, host filesystem, local Chromium, or unsafe origin-fallback flag. Tools run with the same restricted pod identity as this one trusted owner.

metadata.name: OpenClaw Browser Sandbox
metadata.description: Headless Chromium browser sandbox that can be controlled via Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). Use this with OpenClaw or other services that need browser automation capabilities. For one trusted owner and caller only: Chromium runs with --no-sandbox and CDP has no application authentication, so it gives no isolation from hostile pages or other users.

inputs.name: clientApp
inputs.description: Explicitly trusted same-namespace caller pod app.kubernetes.io/name label; use openclaw for openclaw. Anyone able to forge this label or create pods in the namespace is trusted.
inputs.label: Trusted caller

zh-CN.label: 信任的调用方
zh-CN.description: 同一个项目里可以调用浏览器的 Pod，填它的 app.kubernetes.io/name 标签；搭配 openclaw 就填 openclaw。能伪造这个标签或在项目里创建 Pod 的人都会被信任。

zh-TW.label: 信任的呼叫端
zh-TW.description: 同一個專案裡可以呼叫瀏覽器的 Pod，填它的 app.kubernetes.io/name 標籤；搭配 openclaw 就填 openclaw。能偽造這個標籤或在專案裡建立 Pod 的人都會被信任。

security.summary: This is a private browser for one owner. It runs without root rights, with a read-only filesystem, no extra privileges and no API token. Only callers you approve can reach it. Outbound traffic is not limited. Upstream turns off Chromium's built-in renderer sandbox, so a hostile web page can take over the browser pod.

zh-CN.summary: 这是给单个所有者用的私人浏览器。它不用 root 权限运行，文件系统只读，没有额外权限，也没有 API token。只有你批准的调用方连得进来。向外的网络流量没有限制。上游把 Chromium 内置的渲染沙箱关掉了，所以恶意网页可以接管浏览器 Pod。

zh-TW.summary: 這是給單一擁有者用的私人瀏覽器。它不用 root 權限執行，檔案系統唯讀，沒有額外權限，也沒有 API token。只有你核准的呼叫端連得進來。往外的網路流量沒有限制。上游把 Chromium 內建的渲染沙箱關掉了，所以惡意網頁可以接管瀏覽器 Pod。

risks.risk: A malicious web page can take over the Chromium process, which has no sandbox. The attacker then gets the pod's full identity and the browser session data.
risks.mitigation: The description says to use it for a single owner. The pod holds no application or provider credentials, no host mounts and no Kubernetes token. Its filesystem is read-only, its state is temporary, its identity is restricted and its resources are limited. The browser can still open private and cloud metadata addresses unless you add an egress NetworkPolicy. Do not share one browser between users who do not trust each other.

zh-CN.risk: 恶意网页可以接管没有沙箱保护的 Chromium 进程。攻击者就能拿到这个 Pod 的完整身份和浏览器的会话数据。
zh-CN.mitigation: 说明里已写明只给单个所有者使用。Pod 里没有应用或供应商的凭证，没有挂载主机目录，也没有 Kubernetes token。文件系统只读，状态只临时保存，身份权限受限，资源也有上限。除非你另外加上 egress NetworkPolicy，否则浏览器还是能打开内网和云端 metadata 地址。不要让互不信任的人共用同一个浏览器。

zh-TW.risk: 惡意網頁可以接管沒有沙箱保護的 Chromium 程序。攻擊者就能拿到這個 Pod 的完整身分和瀏覽器的工作階段資料。
zh-TW.mitigation: 說明裡已寫明只給單一擁有者使用。Pod 裡沒有應用程式或供應商的憑證，沒有掛載主機目錄，也沒有 Kubernetes token。檔案系統唯讀，狀態只暫存，身分權限受限，資源也有上限。除非你另外加上 egress NetworkPolicy，否則瀏覽器還是能開啟內網和雲端 metadata 位址。不要讓互不信任的人共用同一個瀏覽器。

risks.risk: The CDP port gives full control of the browser, and the proxy in front of it checks no password.
risks.mitigation: There is no public Ingress or LoadBalancer. A NetworkPolicy lets in only callers in the same namespace that carry the approved label, and only on port 9222. Anyone who can write pods or labels in that namespace is trusted. The browser runs headless only, and VNC and noVNC are turned off.

zh-CN.risk: CDP 端口可以完全控制浏览器，而前面的代理不会检查任何密码。
zh-CN.mitigation: 没有对外的 Ingress 或 LoadBalancer。NetworkPolicy 只放行同一个命名空间里带有批准标签的调用方，而且只开 9222 端口。能在该命名空间创建 Pod 或改标签的人都视为可信任。浏览器只以无头模式运行，VNC 和 noVNC 都已关闭。

zh-TW.risk: CDP 連接埠可以完全控制瀏覽器，而前面的代理不會檢查任何密碼。
zh-TW.mitigation: 沒有對外的 Ingress 或 LoadBalancer。NetworkPolicy 只放行同一個命名空間裡帶有核准標籤的呼叫端，而且只開 9222 連接埠。能在該命名空間建立 Pod 或改標籤的人都視為可信任。瀏覽器只以無頭模式執行，VNC 和 noVNC 都已關閉。

scalability.summary: One ephemeral browser/profile per trusted owner; independent sessions are not horizontally interchangeable.
blockers: CDP session state is process-local and ephemeral; no cross-owner shared profiles.

upgradeNotes: Update the launch script, Chromium, base packages and the Caddy CDP proxy together. Check the new image digest and license.
The template runs headless CDP on port 9222 only. It has no headful or VNC mode, no renderer sandbox and no CDP authentication.
Configure OpenClaw attachOnly browser profile with cdpUrl http://openclaw-sandbox-browser:9222.

Browser cookies and sessions are ephemeral and lost on restart; never treat this as durable storage or a secure cookie vault. Encrypt any exported browser data and keep it off the cluster, because it holds credentials.

metadata.name: OpenList
metadata.description: File listing and WebDAV with FFmpeg and authenticated local Aria2 downloads.

inputs.name: adminPassword
inputs.description: Password for the OpenList user admin. It is applied again at each restart, so a password changed in the UI is lost on restart. Change this Secret to rotate it.

inputs.name: aria2Password
inputs.description: Aria2 loopback JSON-RPC secret. In OpenList offline download settings, set endpoint http://127.0.0.1:6800/jsonrpc and this token.

security.summary: The workloads live in their own namespace, run without root rights, use pinned image versions and have read-only root filesystems. They have no Kubernetes token and no extra Linux capabilities. Outbound traffic is not limited.

zh-CN.summary: 所有工作负载都放在自己的命名空间，不用 root 权限运行，镜像版本固定，根文件系统只读。它们没有 Kubernetes token，也没有额外的 Linux 权限。向外的网络流量没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: 所有工作負載都放在自己的命名空間，不用 root 權限執行，映像檔版本固定，根檔案系統唯讀。它們沒有 Kubernetes token，也沒有額外的 Linux 權限。往外的網路流量沒有限制。

risks.risk: The upstream all-in-one Aria2 setup has no RPC password, and download providers can point it at any URL.
risks.mitigation: The template starts Aria2 with a password-protected RPC that listens on loopback only, and it keeps FFmpeg, BitTorrent and downloads working. Outbound traffic is not limited, so download URLs can reach private and cloud metadata addresses. Add an egress NetworkPolicy to block them.

zh-CN.risk: 上游的一体式 Aria2 设置没有 RPC 密码，下载来源可以让它去抓任何网址。
zh-CN.mitigation: 这个模板启动 Aria2 时开启了 RPC 密码验证，而且只监听本机回环，同时保留 FFmpeg、BitTorrent 和下载功能。向外的网络流量没有限制，所以下载网址可以连到内网和云端 metadata 地址。请加上 egress NetworkPolicy 把它们挡掉。

zh-TW.risk: 上游的一體式 Aria2 設定沒有 RPC 密碼，下載來源可以叫它去抓任何網址。
zh-TW.mitigation: 這個範本啟動 Aria2 時有開 RPC 密碼驗證，而且只監聽本機迴路，同時保留 FFmpeg、BitTorrent 和下載功能。往外的網路流量沒有限制，所以下載網址可以連到內網和雲端 metadata 位址。請加上 egress NetworkPolicy 把它們擋掉。

risks.risk: Storage credentials and administrator password hashes are kept in the SQLite data volume.
risks.mitigation: Limit who can read the PVC, the Secrets and the logs. Use the generated administrator credentials. Encrypt any backup you store off the node.

zh-CN.risk: 存储空间的凭证和管理员密码的哈希值都放在 SQLite 数据卷里。
zh-CN.mitigation: 限制谁能读取 PVC、机密和日志。使用自动生成的管理员账号密码。存到节点外的备份要加密。

zh-TW.risk: 儲存空間的憑證和管理員密碼的雜湊值都放在 SQLite 資料磁碟區裡。
zh-TW.mitigation: 限制誰能讀取 PVC、機密和日誌。使用自動產生的管理員帳密。存到節點外的備份要加密。

risks.risk: OpenList uses the AGPL-3.0 license. If you change it and offer it over a network, you must give your users the source code.
risks.mitigation: Run the unmodified image, or publish your changes under AGPL-3.0. Keep the license notices.

zh-CN.risk: OpenList 采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。如果你改过代码，又通过网络提供给别人用，就必须把源代码提供给用户。
zh-CN.mitigation: 使用没改过的镜像，或者把你的修改用 AGPL-3.0 公开。保留许可声明。

zh-TW.risk: OpenList 採用 AGPL-3.0 授權。如果你改過程式，又透過網路提供給別人用，就必須把原始碼提供給使用者。
zh-TW.mitigation: 使用沒改過的映像檔，或是把你的修改用 AGPL-3.0 公開。保留授權聲明。

scalability.summary: One writable instance on one volume, with no failover.
blockers: A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.
A single writable application instance is intentional; do not increase replicas without an application-specific storage/database design.

upgradeNotes: Back up persistent application data and its database to storage outside the node before updating the image digest. Stop OpenList and Aria2 first so the SQLite database and download state are consistent.
Database migrations can be one-way. Restore a copy into a separate namespace and test the upgrade there first: storage access, admin login, WebDAV, FFmpeg and an Aria2 task.
The pinned image is v4.2.7-aio. The upstream latest-aio tag moves; update only by changing the pinned digest.
The container timezone is Asia/Shanghai. Change the TZ variable if you need another zone.

metadata.name: PostgreSQL with pgvector
metadata.description: CloudNativePG PostgreSQL 18 standard image with pgvector enabled.

security.summary: The CloudNativePG operator (CNPG) runs the database pods without root rights and sets up permissions for each cluster. There is no public database port and no superuser login. SQL extensions are created only when the database is first set up.

zh-CN.summary: CloudNativePG 运算符（CNPG）让数据库 Pod 不用 root 权限运行，并为每个集群设好权限。数据库没有对外的端口，也不能用超级用户登录。SQL 扩展只在数据库第一次创建时安装。

zh-TW.summary: CloudNativePG 運算子（CNPG）讓資料庫 Pod 不用 root 權限執行，並替每個叢集設好權限。資料庫沒有對外的連接埠，也不能用超級使用者登入。SQL 擴充套件只在資料庫第一次建立時安裝。

risks.risk: The database pods need a Kubernetes API token, which the operator manages. The template itself creates no Role or binding.
risks.mitigation: Check the permissions the catalog operator creates and the pods it generates. Leave token automount on for the database pods, because the operator needs it.

zh-CN.risk: 数据库 Pod 需要一个 Kubernetes API token，由运算符负责管理。这个模板本身不会创建任何 Role 或绑定。
zh-CN.mitigation: 检查目录里的运算符创建了哪些权限，以及它生成的 Pod。数据库 Pod 的 token 自动挂载要保持开启，因为运算符需要它。

zh-TW.risk: 資料庫 Pod 需要一個 Kubernetes API token，由運算子負責管理。這個範本本身不會建立任何 Role 或綁定。
zh-TW.mitigation: 檢查目錄裡的運算子建立了哪些權限，以及它產生的 Pod。資料庫 Pod 的 token 自動掛載要保持開啟，因為運算子需要它。

risks.risk: Local-path storage has no snapshots and no availability across nodes. The extension and plugin images are extra software you have to trust.
risks.mitigation: Check the operator release, the database image digest and your backups. Test a restore with pgvector before you go to production and before upgrades.

zh-CN.risk: Local-path 存储没有快照，也不能跨节点保持可用。扩展和插件的镜像是额外要信任的软件。
zh-CN.mitigation: 检查运算符的版本、数据库镜像的 digest 和备份。正式上线前和升级前，都要用 pgvector 实际测试恢复。

zh-TW.risk: Local-path 儲存沒有快照，也不能跨節點維持可用。擴充套件和外掛的映像檔是額外要信任的軟體。
zh-TW.mitigation: 檢查運算子的版本、資料庫映像檔的 digest 和備份。正式上線前和升級前，都要用 pgvector 實際測試還原。

risks.risk: A backup that finished without errors does not prove that your vectors and indexes restore correctly.
risks.mitigation: Run a restore drill with representative vectors before production.

zh-CN.risk: 备份顺利跑完，不代表向量和索引一定能正确恢复。
zh-CN.mitigation: 正式上线前，用有代表性的向量数据实际演练一次恢复。

zh-TW.risk: 備份順利跑完，不代表向量和索引一定能正確還原。
zh-TW.mitigation: 正式上線前，用有代表性的向量資料實際演練一次還原。

scalability.summary: Single primary with a 10Gi volume; vector indexes may need substantially more memory and disk. No HPA. Read replicas require separate nodes and a CNPG capacity check.
blockers: On a node-local StorageClass, node loss requires a restore from a remote backup.
Vector dimensions, index memory and extension versions constrain migrations.
The PodDisruptionBudget (enablePDB) protects the single instance from voluntary eviction and can block node drains.

upgradeNotes: Database backups are off when the template is installed. To turn them on, open the database in Zeabur and use the Backups tab.

Connect to postgresql-rw:5432, database zeabur, owner app, with credentials from the operator-generated postgresql-app Secret. Superuser access is disabled. Client Pods in the same namespace need the label templates.zeabur.com/postgresql-client=true.
Check PostgreSQL and pgvector release compatibility; back up and test restore with representative vectors.
Do not treat a major PostgreSQL image change as a rolling minor update; plan the CNPG major upgrade or logical migration.

postInitApplicationSQL only runs on initial bootstrap. To upgrade the extension, check pg_extension.extversion, pgvector release notes and index compatibility, then run ALTER EXTENSION vector UPDATE as a planned migration.

metadata.name: Qdrant
metadata.description: Qdrant vector database with API key authentication and data on a persistent volume.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.description: API key for every REST and gRPC request, sent in the api-key header. Generated at installation.

security.summary: The official image runs as an unprivileged user (UID 1000) with a read-only root filesystem, no service-account token and no extra Linux capabilities. Every Qdrant request needs the API key.

zh-CN.summary: 官方镜像以普通用户（UID 1000）运行，根文件系统只读，没有 service-account token，也没有额外的 Linux 权限。每个 Qdrant 请求都要带 API 密钥。

zh-TW.summary: 官方映像檔以一般使用者（UID 1000）執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有 service-account token，也沒有額外的 Linux 權限。每個 Qdrant 請求都要帶 API 金鑰。

risks.risk: The REST API and the web dashboard are public through the Ingress.
risks.mitigation: Every request needs the generated API key, except the health endpoints. Keep the key on your servers, and create JWT or read-only keys for other clients.

zh-CN.risk: REST API 和网页管理界面都通过 Ingress 对外公开。
zh-CN.mitigation: 除了健康检查端点，每个请求都要带自动生成的 API 密钥。密钥只放在你的服务器上，给其他客户端用的话，另外创建 JWT 或只读密钥。

zh-TW.risk: REST API 和網頁管理介面都透過 Ingress 對外公開。
zh-TW.mitigation: 除了健康檢查端點，每個請求都要帶自動產生的 API 金鑰。金鑰只放在你的伺服器上，給其他用戶端用的話，另外建立 JWT 或唯讀金鑰。

risks.risk: The gRPC port is not exposed through the Ingress.
risks.mitigation: Pods in the same namespace with the label templates.zeabur.com/qdrant-client=true can reach REST on port 6333 and gRPC on port 6334. From outside the cluster, use REST over the Ingress.

zh-CN.risk: gRPC 端口不会通过 Ingress 对外开放。
zh-CN.mitigation: 同一个命名空间里，带有标签 templates.zeabur.com/qdrant-client=true 的 Pod 可以连 6333 的 REST 和 6334 的 gRPC。从集群外面连的话，请走 Ingress 的 REST。

zh-TW.risk: gRPC 連接埠不會透過 Ingress 對外開放。
zh-TW.mitigation: 同一個命名空間裡，帶有標籤 templates.zeabur.com/qdrant-client=true 的 Pod 可以連 6333 的 REST 和 6334 的 gRPC。從叢集外面連的話，請走 Ingress 的 REST。

risks.risk: Outbound traffic is not limited, so a snapshot URL can point at private addresses.
risks.mitigation: Upload snapshots through the API, or add an egress NetworkPolicy that limits where Qdrant can fetch from.

zh-CN.risk: 向外的网络流量没有限制，所以快照网址可以指向内网地址。
zh-CN.mitigation: 用 API 上传快照，或者加上 egress NetworkPolicy，限制 Qdrant 能从哪里下载。

zh-TW.risk: 往外的網路流量沒有限制，所以快照網址可以指向內網位址。
zh-TW.mitigation: 用 API 上傳快照，或是加上 egress NetworkPolicy，限制 Qdrant 能從哪裡下載。

scalability.summary: One node on a 20Gi volume. Distributed mode is not configured.
blockers: More replicas need Qdrant distributed mode with peer discovery and a volume per node. The template does not configure it.
A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.

upgradeNotes: Create a full snapshot with the snapshot API and copy it off the node before you change the image digest.
Qdrant supports upgrades from the previous minor version only. Upgrade one minor version at a time. A rollback needs the snapshot taken before the upgrade.
Deleting the namespace deletes the PVC and all collections. Keep snapshots outside the cluster.

metadata.name: SearXNG
metadata.description: Privacy-respecting metasearch with generated signing secret and HTML/JSON search.

inputs.name: signingKey
inputs.description: Persistent server signing key; generated at installation.

security.summary: SearXNG runs without root rights, with a read-only root filesystem, no service-account token and no extra Linux capabilities. Only Traefik can reach it, over HTTPS. Outbound traffic is not limited.

zh-CN.summary: SearXNG 不用 root 权限运行，根文件系统只读，没有 service-account token，也没有额外的 Linux 权限。只有 Traefik 能通过 HTTPS 连到它。向外的网络流量没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: SearXNG 不用 root 權限執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有 service-account token，也沒有額外的 Linux 權限。只有 Traefik 能透過 HTTPS 連到它。往外的網路流量沒有限制。

risks.risk: If the search is open to the public, others can abuse it, and the upstream search engines may slow down or block this server.
risks.mitigation: Public instance mode is off, and the Valkey-backed rate limiter is not turned on. Use this instance for private, low-volume search. Before you publish it, add sign-in and rate limiting at the ingress.

zh-CN.risk: 搜索如果对外公开，可能被人滥用，上游的搜索引擎也可能限速或封禁这台服务器。
zh-CN.mitigation: 公开实例模式是关闭的，基于 Valkey 的流量限制器也没有开。请只用于私人、查询量小的搜索。要对外公开之前，先在 ingress 加上登录验证和流量限制。

zh-TW.risk: 搜尋如果對外公開，可能被人濫用，上游的搜尋引擎也可能限速或封鎖這台伺服器。
zh-TW.mitigation: 公開實例模式是關閉的，用 Valkey 的流量限制器也沒有開。請只用在私人、查詢量小的搜尋。要對外公開之前，先在 ingress 加上登入驗證和流量限制。

risks.risk: SearXNG must reach many search engines on the public Internet, so your search terms leave this cluster.
risks.mitigation: The template does not limit outbound traffic. Read the privacy policy of each search engine you turn on.

zh-CN.risk: SearXNG 要连到公共网络上的许多搜索引擎，所以你的搜索关键词会离开这个集群。
zh-CN.mitigation: 这个模板不限制向外的网络流量。请读过你开启的每个搜索引擎的隐私政策。

zh-TW.risk: SearXNG 要連到公開網路上的許多搜尋引擎，所以你的搜尋關鍵字會離開這個叢集。
zh-TW.mitigation: 這個範本不限制往外的網路流量。請讀過你開啟的每個搜尋引擎的隱私權政策。

risks.risk: SearXNG uses the AGPL-3.0-or-later license.
risks.mitigation: If you change the code or offer it to other users, publish the matching source code as the license requires.

zh-CN.risk: SearXNG 采用 AGPL-3.0-or-later 许可。
zh-CN.mitigation: 如果你改过代码，或者提供给其他人使用，按许可要求公开对应的源代码。

zh-TW.risk: SearXNG 採用 AGPL-3.0-or-later 授權。
zh-TW.mitigation: 如果你改過程式碼，或是提供給其他人使用，依授權要求公開對應的原始碼。

scalability.summary: One replica. Cache is ephemeral and a restart clears it. The instance stores no user data.
blockers: More replicas need a shared rate limiter. The template does not provide one.

upgradeNotes: Pinned image version 2026.10.19-81371861f. On updates, check settings, entrypoint and search engine compatibility.
Settings are in a ConfigMap. Change them there; changes inside the container are lost on restart. Cache is disposable. No database or PVC backup is needed.
The signing key in app-secrets persists for the installation. Include it in encrypted secret backups.

metadata.name: SillyTavern
metadata.description: Private LLM frontend with generated Basic authentication and persistent conversations.

inputs.name: basicPassword
inputs.description: Basic authentication password for username user; generated, never a shared default.

security.summary: SillyTavern runs without root rights, with a read-only root filesystem, no service-account token and no extra Linux capabilities. Only Traefik can reach it, over HTTPS. Outbound traffic is not limited.

zh-CN.summary: SillyTavern 不用 root 权限运行，根文件系统只读，没有 service-account token，也没有额外的 Linux 权限。只有 Traefik 能通过 HTTPS 连到它。向外的网络流量没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: SillyTavern 不用 root 權限執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有 service-account token，也沒有額外的 Linux 權限。只有 Traefik 能透過 HTTPS 連到它。往外的網路流量沒有限制。

risks.risk: A signed-in user can set up outbound model and API connections, and can read the stored provider keys and chats.
risks.mitigation: This is meant for one trusted user. Access uses a generated Basic auth password over HTTPS. SillyTavern blocks private addresses on its own, but the template does not limit outbound traffic. Do not share the credentials with people you do not trust.

zh-CN.risk: 登录的用户可以设置对外的模型和 API 连接，也能看到存放的供应商密钥和聊天记录。
zh-CN.mitigation: 这是设计给单个可信任的用户用的。访问靠自动生成的 Basic auth 密码，并走 HTTPS。SillyTavern 自己会挡内网地址，但这个模板不限制向外的网络流量。不要把账号密码分享给你不信任的人。

zh-TW.risk: 登入的使用者可以設定對外的模型和 API 連線，也能看到存放的供應商金鑰和聊天紀錄。
zh-TW.mitigation: 這是設計給單一可信任的使用者用的。存取靠自動產生的 Basic auth 密碼，並走 HTTPS。SillyTavern 自己會擋內網位址，但這個範本不限制往外的網路流量。不要把帳密分享給你不信任的人。

risks.risk: Plugins and extensions run code on the server or scripts in the browser.
risks.mitigation: Server plugins are turned off. Automatic extension updates and model downloads are turned off too. Read the code of each extension before you install it.

zh-CN.risk: 插件和扩展会在服务器上运行代码，或者在浏览器里运行脚本。
zh-CN.mitigation: 服务器插件已关闭，扩展的自动更新和模型下载也都关闭了。安装每个扩展之前，先看过它的代码。

zh-TW.risk: 外掛和擴充功能會在伺服器上執行程式，或是在瀏覽器裡執行腳本。
zh-TW.mitigation: 伺服器外掛已關閉，擴充功能的自動更新和模型下載也都關閉了。安裝每個擴充功能之前，先看過它的程式碼。

scalability.summary: One replica. On a node-local StorageClass, node loss requires manual recovery from off-node backups.
blockers: Sessions and rate limits are per process; multiple replicas are not supported
A node-local StorageClass has no snapshots. In-app chat backups stay on the same PVC and do not protect against node loss

upgradeNotes: Pin 1.19.0 by registry index digest; preserve app-secrets and all PVC subdirectories before updates.

Stop the Deployment before copying the PVC off-node. A node-local StorageClass has no snapshots or failover. Restore with the same generated authentication secret. Do not run an older image on a PVC that a newer version has migrated.
Login is HTTP Basic user user with the password in app-secrets/basic-password. SillyTavern keeps its session secret in the data directory.

config.yaml is rebuilt from the ConfigMap at each start; settings changed only in the file are lost. Edit the ConfigMap instead. The host whitelist contains only the deployment domain; render the template again if the domain changes.

metadata.name: Umami
metadata.description: Umami web analytics over HTTPS, with PostgreSQL 18 managed by CloudNativePG.

inputs.name: adminPassword
inputs.description: Password of the admin user. It replaces the default password once, at the first start. Change it in Umami after you sign in.

inputs.name: appSecret
inputs.description: Signs sign-in tokens and share links. Rotating it signs everyone out.

security.summary: Umami runs as an unprivileged user (UID 1001) with a read-only root filesystem, no service-account token and no extra Linux capabilities. Outbound traffic is not limited, but Umami makes no outbound requests.

zh-CN.summary: Umami 以普通用户（UID 1001）运行，根文件系统只读，没有 service-account token，也没有额外的 Linux 权限。向外的网络流量没有限制，不过 Umami 本身不会对外发出请求。

zh-TW.summary: Umami 以一般使用者（UID 1001）執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有 service-account token，也沒有額外的 Linux 權限。往外的網路流量沒有限制，不過 Umami 本身不會對外發出請求。

risks.risk: Umami creates the admin account with the published password umami.
risks.mitigation: An init container replaces that password with a generated one before Umami starts. It replaces only the default password, so a password you set in Umami stays.

zh-CN.risk: Umami 会用公开的密码 umami 创建管理员账号。
zh-CN.mitigation: Umami 启动之前，初始化容器会把这个密码换成自动生成的密码。它只会换掉默认密码，所以你在 Umami 里自己设的密码不会被改掉。

zh-TW.risk: Umami 會用公開的密碼 umami 建立管理員帳號。
zh-TW.mitigation: Umami 啟動之前，初始化容器會把這個密碼換成自動產生的密碼。它只會換掉預設密碼，所以你在 Umami 裡自己設的密碼不會被改掉。

risks.risk: The tracking endpoint accepts events from any website.
risks.mitigation: Umami stores events only for website IDs that exist in Umami.

zh-CN.risk: 跟踪端点会接受任何网站发来的事件。
zh-CN.mitigation: Umami 只会保存 Umami 里已经存在的网站 ID 的事件。

zh-TW.risk: 追蹤端點會接受任何網站送來的事件。
zh-TW.mitigation: Umami 只會儲存 Umami 裡已經存在的網站 ID 的事件。

risks.risk: The database pods (CloudNativePG) call the Kubernetes API with an identity that the operator creates.
risks.mitigation: The databases/cloudnative-pg component creates the permissions (RBAC) for each cluster. The Umami pod itself has no token.

zh-CN.risk: 数据库 Pod（CloudNativePG）会用运算符创建的身份去调用 Kubernetes API。
zh-CN.mitigation: databases/cloudnative-pg 组件会为每个集群创建对应的权限（RBAC）。Umami 的 Pod 本身没有 token。

zh-TW.risk: 資料庫 Pod（CloudNativePG）會用運算子建立的身分去呼叫 Kubernetes API。
zh-TW.mitigation: databases/cloudnative-pg 元件會替每個叢集建立對應的權限（RBAC）。Umami 的 Pod 本身沒有 token。

scalability.summary: One Umami instance with one PostgreSQL primary.
blockers: The init container migrates the database. More replicas need the migration moved to a separate step.

upgradeNotes: Database backups are off when the template is installed. To turn them on, open the database in Zeabur and use the Backups tab.
The init container runs prisma migrate deploy before the new version starts. A rollback needs the database backup taken before the upgrade.
Deleting the namespace deletes the database. Backups in S3 stay.

metadata.name: Uptime Kuma
metadata.description: Self-hosted uptime monitoring with persistent SQLite data.

security.summary: The workloads live in their own namespace, run without root rights, use pinned image versions and have read-only root filesystems. They have no Kubernetes token and no extra Linux capabilities. Outbound traffic is not limited.

zh-CN.summary: 所有工作负载都放在自己的命名空间，不用 root 权限运行，镜像版本固定，根文件系统只读。它们没有 Kubernetes token，也没有额外的 Linux 权限。向外的网络流量没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: 所有工作負載都放在自己的命名空間，不用 root 權限執行，映像檔版本固定，根檔案系統唯讀。它們沒有 Kubernetes token，也沒有額外的 Linux 權限。往外的網路流量沒有限制。

risks.risk: The first visitor can claim an installation that is not set up yet.
risks.mitigation: Uptime Kuma has no environment variable or init step that creates the owner, so the template cannot do it at deploy time. Open the domain and create the owner account right after the deploy finishes. Until then, whoever visits first becomes the owner. The monitor page, the setup page and the status pages are open to anyone who can reach the domain, and only the application's own sign-in protects the rest. To limit who can reach it, add an IP limit in the service's network settings.

zh-CN.risk: 还没设置好的时候，第一个打开网站的人就能认领这个安装。
zh-CN.mitigation: Uptime Kuma 没有环境变量或初始化步骤可以创建所有者，所以模板没办法在部署时帮你创建。部署完成后请马上打开域名，创建所有者账号。在那之前，谁先进来谁就是所有者。监控页面、设置页面和状态页面，任何连得到域名的人都看得到，其余部分只靠应用自己的登录保护。想限制谁能连进来，请在服务的网络设置里加上 IP 限制。

zh-TW.risk: 還沒設定好的時候，第一個打開網站的人就能認領這個安裝。
zh-TW.mitigation: Uptime Kuma 沒有環境變數或初始化步驟可以建立擁有者，所以範本沒辦法在部署時幫你建。部署完成後請馬上打開網域，建立擁有者帳號。在那之前，誰先進來誰就是擁有者。監控頁面、設定頁面和狀態頁面，任何連得到網域的人都看得到，其餘部分只靠應用程式自己的登入保護。想限制誰能連進來，請在服務的網路設定裡加上 IP 限制。

risks.risk: Someone could set a monitoring target that makes Uptime Kuma reach into your cluster or private network (an SSRF attack).
risks.mitigation: The template does not limit outbound traffic. Add an egress NetworkPolicy that allows only the destination range you approve. Never mount a Docker socket or turn on privileged monitoring.

zh-CN.risk: 有人可以设置监控目标，让 Uptime Kuma 去连你的集群或内部网络（SSRF 攻击）。
zh-CN.mitigation: 这个模板不限制向外的网络流量。请加上 egress NetworkPolicy，只放行你批准的目的地范围。绝对不要挂载 Docker socket，也不要开启特权监控。

zh-TW.risk: 有人可以設定監控目標，讓 Uptime Kuma 去連你的叢集或內部網路（SSRF 攻擊）。
zh-TW.mitigation: 這個範本不限制往外的網路流量。請加上 egress NetworkPolicy，只放行你核准的目的地範圍。絕對不要掛載 Docker socket，也不要開啟特權監控。

risks.risk: Ping monitors use unprivileged ICMP sockets, set through the net.ipv4.ping_group_range sysctl. The container has no NET_RAW capability. Monitors that need raw sockets or the Docker socket do not work.
risks.mitigation: Check how your CNI handles ICMP. Use HTTP, TCP or DNS monitors where ping fails.

zh-CN.risk: Ping 监控用的是不需特权的 ICMP socket，靠 net.ipv4.ping_group_range 这个 sysctl 设置。容器没有 NET_RAW 权限。需要原始 socket 或 Docker socket 的监控项目没办法用。
zh-CN.mitigation: 检查你的 CNI 怎么处理 ICMP。Ping 不通的地方，改用 HTTP、TCP 或 DNS 监控。

zh-TW.risk: Ping 監控用的是不需特權的 ICMP socket，靠 net.ipv4.ping_group_range 這個 sysctl 設定。容器沒有 NET_RAW 權限。需要原始 socket 或 Docker socket 的監控項目沒辦法用。
zh-TW.mitigation: 檢查你的 CNI 怎麼處理 ICMP。Ping 不通的地方，改用 HTTP、TCP 或 DNS 監控。

scalability.summary: One writable instance on a 10Gi volume with SQLite. There is no high availability.
blockers: A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.
The template runs one writable instance. Do not increase replicas without an application-specific storage/database design.

upgradeNotes: A new install has no owner until someone creates it on the first visit. Do that right after the deploy; Uptime Kuma cannot create it from a Secret.
Back up persistent application data and its database to storage outside the node before updating the image digest.
Test a restore into a separate namespace before upgrading. Database migrations may not be reversible.
Back up /app/data while Uptime Kuma is stopped, or with a SQLite-consistent backup tool. A copy of a live SQLite file can be inconsistent.
Upgrades from 2.0 to 2.5 migrate the database schema. Test the migration on a restored copy first. Rolling back the image does not undo schema migrations.

metadata.name: Vaultwarden
metadata.description: Vaultwarden, a Bitwarden-compatible password manager server, with SQLite on a persistent volume. Sign-up is closed; the administrator invites users.

inputs.name: adminToken
inputs.description: Token for the admin page at /admin, where you invite users. Generated at installation.

security.summary: Vaultwarden runs as an unprivileged user (UID 1000) with a read-only root filesystem, no service-account token and no extra Linux capabilities. Outbound traffic is not limited. Sign-up is closed.

zh-CN.summary: Vaultwarden 以普通用户（UID 1000）运行，根文件系统只读，没有 service-account token，也没有额外的 Linux 权限。向外的网络流量没有限制。注册功能是关闭的。

zh-TW.summary: Vaultwarden 以一般使用者（UID 1000）執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有 service-account token，也沒有額外的 Linux 權限。往外的網路流量沒有限制。註冊功能是關閉的。

risks.risk: Anyone who can reach the server could create an account.
risks.mitigation: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED is false. Sign in to /admin with the token in vaultwarden-secrets, and invite users by email. Without SMTP, an invited address can register directly.

zh-CN.risk: 任何连得到服务器的人都可能创建账号。
zh-CN.mitigation: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED 设为 false。用 vaultwarden-secrets 里的 token 登录 /admin，再用邮箱邀请用户。没有配置 SMTP 的话，被邀请的邮箱可以直接注册。

zh-TW.risk: 任何連得到伺服器的人都可能建立帳號。
zh-TW.mitigation: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED 設為 false。用 vaultwarden-secrets 裡的 token 登入 /admin，再用 Email 邀請使用者。沒有設定 SMTP 的話，被邀請的 Email 可以直接註冊。

risks.risk: The admin token is stored as plain text in a Secret. Vaultwarden logs a notice that recommends an Argon2 hash instead.
risks.mitigation: Limit who can read the Secret. To use a hash, run vaultwarden hash in a terminal and store the resulting PHC string in the Secret.

zh-CN.risk: 管理员 token 以纯文本放在机密里。Vaultwarden 会在日志里提醒你改用 Argon2 哈希值。
zh-CN.mitigation: 限制谁能读取这个机密。想改用哈希值的话，在终端执行 vaultwarden hash，再把生成的 PHC 字符串存进机密。

zh-TW.risk: 管理員 token 以純文字放在機密裡。Vaultwarden 會在日誌裡提醒你改用 Argon2 雜湊值。
zh-TW.mitigation: 限制誰能讀取這個機密。想改用雜湊值的話，在終端機執行 vaultwarden hash，再把產生的 PHC 字串存進機密。

risks.risk: The admin page is public through the Ingress.
risks.mitigation: It needs the 43-character admin token. To remove the page, delete the ADMIN_TOKEN variable after you have invited your users.

zh-CN.risk: 管理页面通过 Ingress 对外公开。
zh-CN.mitigation: 进去需要 43 个字符的管理员 token。邀请完用户之后，删掉 ADMIN_TOKEN 变量，就能把这个页面关掉。

zh-TW.risk: 管理頁面透過 Ingress 對外公開。
zh-TW.mitigation: 進去需要 43 個字元的管理員 token。邀請完使用者之後，刪掉 ADMIN_TOKEN 變數，就能把這個頁面關掉。

risks.risk: No SMTP server is set up, so invitation emails, two-factor emails and emergency access emails are not sent.
risks.mitigation: Set the SMTP_ variables.

zh-CN.risk: 没有配置 SMTP 服务器，所以邀请邮件、两步验证邮件和紧急访问邮件都发不出去。
zh-CN.mitigation: 设置 SMTP_ 开头的变量。

zh-TW.risk: 沒有設定 SMTP 伺服器，所以邀請信、兩步驟驗證信和緊急存取信都寄不出去。
zh-TW.mitigation: 設定 SMTP_ 開頭的變數。

risks.risk: The icon service downloads favicons from the websites your users save.
risks.mitigation: Vaultwarden refuses non-global (private) addresses by default. Set ICON_SERVICE=none to turn the icon service off.

zh-CN.risk: 图标服务会从用户保存的网站下载网站图标。
zh-CN.mitigation: Vaultwarden 默认会拒绝非公网（内网）的地址。想关掉图标服务，就设置 ICON_SERVICE=none。

zh-TW.risk: 圖示服務會從使用者儲存的網站下載網站圖示。
zh-TW.mitigation: Vaultwarden 預設會拒絕非公開網路（內網）的位址。想關掉圖示服務，就設定 ICON_SERVICE=none。

scalability.summary: One instance with SQLite on a 10Gi volume.
blockers: SQLite allows one writer, and attachments, sends and the RSA key are on the volume. More replicas need PostgreSQL and shared file storage.
A node-local default StorageClass, such as local-path, has no snapshots or failover.

upgradeNotes: Back up /data off the node before you change the image digest: db.sqlite3 (with sqlite3 .backup, or with Vaultwarden stopped), attachments, sends, config.json and rsa_key.pem. Losing rsa_key.pem signs out every client.
Vaultwarden migrates the database on start. A rollback needs the backup taken before the upgrade.
Deleting the namespace deletes the PVC and every vault.

security.summary: The WordPress and MariaDB pods run without root rights under restricted settings. The database requires TLS, and the SQL credentials are generated. The operator's helper images are part of what you trust when you use this catalog.

zh-CN.summary: WordPress 和 MariaDB 的 Pod 都不用 root 权限运行，并应用严格限制。数据库一律要用 TLS 连接，SQL 账号密码是自动生成的。运算符的辅助镜像，是你使用这个目录时必须信任的一部分。

zh-TW.summary: WordPress 和 MariaDB 的 Pod 都不用 root 權限執行，並套用嚴格限制。資料庫一律要用 TLS 連線，SQL 帳密是自動產生的。運算子的輔助映像檔，是你使用這個目錄時必須信任的一部分。

risks.risk: WordPress plugins and themes run code that can reach the database and the uploaded files.
risks.mitigation: Limit who is an administrator, check plugins before you install them and keep them updated. There is no public FastCGI port. PHP cannot run in the uploads folder, and requests for wp-config, hidden files and raw backup files are denied.

zh-CN.risk: WordPress 的插件和主题会运行代码，这些代码碰得到数据库和上传的文件。
zh-CN.mitigation: 限制管理员人数，安装插件前先检查，并且持续更新。FastCGI 端口没有对外开放。上传文件夹里不能运行 PHP，wp-config、隐藏文件和原始备份文件的请求也会被挡下来。

zh-TW.risk: WordPress 的外掛和佈景主題會執行程式，這些程式碰得到資料庫和上傳的檔案。
zh-TW.mitigation: 限制管理員人數，安裝外掛前先檢查，並且持續更新。FastCGI 連接埠沒有對外開放。上傳資料夾裡不能執行 PHP，wp-config、隱藏檔和原始備份檔的請求也會被擋下來。

risks.risk: On a WordPress site that is not set up yet, the first visitor can claim the site.
risks.mitigation: An init container (official WP-CLI, pinned by digest) creates the admin account with a generated password before the web pods become ready. Nothing is downloaded while it runs.

zh-CN.risk: WordPress 还没设置好的时候，第一个打开网站的人就能认领这个网站。
zh-CN.mitigation: 网页 Pod 准备好之前，初始化容器（官方的 WP-CLI，用 digest 固定版本）会先用自动生成的密码创建管理员账号。运行过程中不会下载任何东西。

zh-TW.risk: WordPress 還沒設定好的時候，第一個打開網站的人就能認領這個網站。
zh-TW.mitigation: 網頁 Pod 準備好之前，初始化容器（官方的 WP-CLI，用 digest 固定版本）會先用自動產生的密碼建立管理員帳號。執行過程中不會下載任何東西。

risks.risk: The MariaDB Operator works across namespaces, so you have to trust it with the whole cluster.
risks.mitigation: Install the exact catalog provider and pin its image settings before you use it. The engine init container uses the template's image digest. MaxScale and Galera are not installed.

zh-CN.risk: MariaDB Operator 会跨命名空间运作，所以你得信任它能管整个集群。
zh-CN.mitigation: 使用之前，装上目录指定的那个提供者，并固定它的镜像设置。引擎的初始化容器沿用模板的镜像 digest。MaxScale 和 Galera 都没有安装。

zh-TW.risk: MariaDB Operator 會跨命名空間運作，所以你得信任它能管整個叢集。
zh-TW.mitigation: 使用之前，裝上目錄指定的那個提供者，並固定它的映像檔設定。引擎的初始化容器沿用範本的映像檔 digest。MaxScale 和 Galera 都沒有安裝。

risks.risk: Database backups do not include the uploads, plugins and themes on the wordpress-data volume.
risks.mitigation: Keep the SQL Secrets and the TLS certificates, and run restore drills. Pause WordPress, then archive the wordpress-data volume and the Secrets at the same recovery point as the database.

zh-CN.risk: 数据库备份不含 wordpress-data 卷里的上传文件、插件和主题。
zh-CN.mitigation: 保留 SQL 机密和 TLS 证书，并且定期演练恢复。先让 WordPress 暂停写入，再把 wordpress-data 卷和机密，跟数据库备份在同一个恢复时间点一起归档。

zh-TW.risk: 資料庫備份不含 wordpress-data 磁碟區裡的上傳檔案、外掛和佈景主題。
zh-TW.mitigation: 保留 SQL 機密和 TLS 憑證，並且定期演練還原。先讓 WordPress 暫停寫入，再把 wordpress-data 磁碟區和機密，跟資料庫備份在同一個還原時間點一起封存。

scalability.summary: One WordPress Pod and one MariaDB writer, each on a 10Gi volume. There is no automatic horizontal scaling.
blockers: A node-local default StorageClass has no HA, snapshots or cross-node failover.

upgradeNotes: Database backups are off when the template is installed. To turn them on, open the database in Zeabur and use the Backups tab.

A Backup of the MariaDB gives its Pods the labels templates.zeabur.com/template: wordpress and app.kubernetes.io/component: backup in spec.podMetadata. MariaDB accepts connections from these Pods. Zeabur adds the labels to the Backups it creates.
Preserve Secrets and PVCs. Back up data off-node and rehearse a restore before changing image digests.
WordPress runs PHP 8.3 on PHP-FPM (UID 82) behind unprivileged NGINX (UID 101). MariaDB is 11.4 LTS. Uploads are capped at 256MiB, PHP memory at 1GiB and execution time at 300s.
WordPress connects to MariaDB with TLS and verifies the server certificate against mariadb-ca-bundle/ca.crt. The trust bundle is built at Pod start; restart WordPress after a MariaDB CA rotation.
The wordpress SQL user has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE, DROP, ALTER and INDEX on zeabur.* only, without GRANT OPTION. Plugins that need other privileges or MySQL-only SQL can fail.

WordPress core/plugins/themes on the persistent HTML volume update through WordPress; changing the seed image does not overwrite existing content. Apply security updates in the admin UI or via /tools/wp inside the WordPress container; retain backups for rollback.

Admin username is admin; retrieve wordpress-secrets/admin-password securely. Initial installation is automatic; do not rerun core install against an existing database. Domain is fixed via WP_HOME/WP_SITEURL; use pinned /tools/wp search-replace for stored links.

Database storage uses operator-owned PVCs. To move from another WordPress deployment, restore a logical dump and the uploads into a separate namespace; do not adopt, mount or downgrade an old datadir. Verify URLs, plugins, TLS and admin login, then move traffic. Keep old PVCs, Secrets and backups until a restore and application acceptance test succeeds.

MariaDB Operator chart26.10.1 retains PVCs on scale/delete via explicit Retain policy. Keep the CRD release installed while any data exists. Engine auto-update is off; check exact-version compatibility before each engine upgrade. Image changes do not reverse SQL migrations.
